For a convicted person who is sentenced to imprisonment for a new criminal offence, the time spent serving this sentence shall not be counted in the probationary period determined by the suspended sentence for the previous offence.
(5) If the court finds that a suspended sentence should also be imposed for the new criminal offence, by applying the provisions of Article 48 of this Code, it shall determine a single sentence for both the previously committed and the new criminal offence and shall determine a new probationary period which may not be shorter than one year nor longer than five years, counting from the day the new judgment becomes final. If the convicted person commits a criminal offence again during the new probationary period, the court shall revoke the suspended sentence and impose a prison sentence, by applying the provision of paragraph 3 of this Article.
Revocation of suspended sentence due to a previously committed criminal offence

heading: Article 56
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 56

(1) Sud će opozvati uslovnu osudu, ako poslije njenog izricanja utvrdi da je osuđeni izvršio krivično djelo prije nego što je uslovno osuđen i ako ocijeni da ne bi bilo osnova za izricanje uslovne osude da se znalo za to djelo. U tom slučaju primijeniće odredbu člana 55 stav 3 ovog zakonika.
(2) Ako sud ne opozove uslovnu osudu, primijeniće odredbu člana 55 stav 4 ovog zakonika.
Opozivanje uslovne osude zbog neispunjenja određenih obaveza
translated_text:
Article 56

(1) The court shall revoke the suspended sentence if, after its imposition, it determines that the convicted person committed a criminal offence before being conditionally sentenced and if it assesses that there would be no grounds for imposing a suspended sentence had that offence been known. In that case, it shall apply the provision of Article 55 paragraph 3 of this Code.
(2) If the court does not revoke the suspended sentence, it shall apply the provision of Article 55 paragraph 4 of this Code.
Revocation of suspended sentence due to non-fulfilment of certain obligations

heading: Article 57
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 57

Ako je uslovnom osudom osuđenom određeno ispunjenje neke obaveze iz člana 53 stav 2 ovog zakonika, a on ne ispuni tu obavezu u roku određenom u presudi, sud može, u okviru vremena provjeravanja, produžiti rok za ispunjenje obaveze ili može opozvati uslovnu osudu i izreći kaznu koja je utvrđena u uslovnoj osudi. Ako utvrdi da osuđeni, iz opravdanih razloga, ne može da ispuni postavljenu obavezu, sud će ga osloboditi od ispunjenja te obaveze ili je zamijeniti drugom odgovarajućom obavezom predviđenom zakonom.
Rokovi za opozivanje uslovne osude
translated_text:
Article 57

If the convicted person has been ordered by the suspended sentence to fulfil an obligation from Article 53 paragraph 2 of this Code, and he does not fulfil that obligation within the time limit specified in the judgment, the court may, within the probationary period, extend the time limit for fulfilment of the obligation or may revoke the suspended sentence and impose the sentence that was determined in the suspended sentence. If it determines that the convicted person, for justified reasons, cannot fulfil the imposed obligation, the court shall release him from fulfilment of that obligation or replace it with another appropriate obligation provided by law.
Time limits for revocation of suspended sentence

heading: Article 58
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 58

(1) Uslovna osuda može se opozvati u toku vremena provjeravanja. Ako osuđeni u tom vremenu učini krivično djelo koje povlači opozivanje uslovne osude, a to je presudom utvrđeno tek poslije isteka vremena provjeravanja, uslovna osuda može se opozvati najkasnije u roku od jedne godine od dana kad je proteklo vrijeme provjeravanja.
(2) Ako osuđeni u određenom roku ne ispuni neku obavezu iz člana 53 stav 2 ovog zakonika, sud može, najdocnije u roku od jedne godine od dana kad je proteklo vrijeme provjeravanja, odrediti da se izvrši utvrđena kazna u uslovnoj osudi.
Uslovna osuda sa zaštitnim nadzorom
translated_text:
Article 58

(1) A suspended sentence may be revoked during the probationary period. If the convicted person commits a criminal offence during that period which entails revocation of the suspended sentence, and this is established by judgment only after the expiry of the probationary period, the suspended sentence may be revoked at the latest within one year from the day the probationary period expired.
(2) If the convicted person does not fulfil an obligation from Article 53 paragraph 2 of this Code within the specified time limit, the court may, at the latest within one year from the day the probationary period expired, order that the sentence determined in the suspended sentence be executed.
Suspended sentence with protective supervision

heading: Article 59
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 59

(1) Sud može odrediti da se učinilac kome je izrečena uslovna osuda stavi pod zaštitni nadzor za određeno vrijeme u toku vremena provjeravanja.
(2) Zaštitni nadzor obuhvata zakonom predviđene mjere pomoći, staranja, nadzora i zaštite.
(3) i (4)
(brisano)
Uslovi za određivanje zaštitnog nadzora
translated_text:
Article 59

(1) The court may order that the perpetrator to whom a suspended sentence has been imposed be placed under protective supervision for a specified time during the probationary period.
(2) Protective supervision includes legally prescribed measures of assistance, care, supervision and protection.
(3) and (4)
(deleted)
Conditions for ordering protective supervision

heading: Article 60
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 60

(1) Kad izrekne uslovnu osudu, sud može odrediti da se učinilac stavi pod zaštitni nadzor, ako se, s obzirom na njegovu ličnost, raniji život, držanje poslije izvršenog krivičnog djela, a naročito njegov odnos prema žrtvi krivičnog djela i okolnosti izvršenja djela, može očekivati da će se zaštitnim nadzorom potpunije ostvariti svrha uslovne osude.
(2) Zaštitni nadzor određuje sud u presudi kojom izriče uslovnu osudu i određuje mjere zaštitnog nadzora, njihovo trajanje i način njihovog ispunjavanja.
Sadržina zaštitnog nadzora
translated_text:
Article 60

(1) When imposing a suspended sentence, the court may order that the perpetrator be placed under protective supervision if, having regard to his personality, previous life, conduct after the commission of the criminal offence, and in particular his relationship to the victim of the criminal offence and the circumstances of the commission of the offence, it can be expected that the purpose of the suspended sentence will be more fully achieved through protective supervision.
(2) Protective supervision is ordered by the court in the judgment imposing the suspended sentence and determines the measures of protective supervision, their duration and the manner of their fulfilment.
Content of protective supervision

heading: Article 61
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex

heading: Article 62
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 62

Pri izboru obaveza iz člana 61 ovog zakonika i određivanja njihovog trajanja, sud će naročito uzeti u obzir godine života učinioca, njegovo zdravstveno stanje, sklonosti i navike, pobude iz kojih je izvršio krivično djelo, držanje poslije izvršenog krivičnog djela, raniji život, lične i porodične prilike, uslove za ispunjenje naloženih obaveza, kao i druge okolnosti koje se odnose na ličnost učinioca, a od značaja su za izbor mjera zaštitnog nadzora i njihovo trajanje.
Trajanje zaštitnog nadzora
translated_text:
Article 62

When selecting the obligations from Article 61 of this Code and determining their duration, the court shall particularly take into account the age of the perpetrator, his state of health, inclinations and habits, the motives from which he committed the criminal offence, his conduct after the commission of the criminal offence, his previous life, personal and family circumstances, conditions for fulfilment of the imposed obligations, as well as other circumstances relating to the personality of the perpetrator that are relevant for the selection of protective supervision measures and their duration.
Duration of protective supervision

heading: Article 63
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 63

(1) Vrijeme trajanja mjera zaštitnog nadzora određuje se u okviru roka provjeravanja utvrđenog u uslovnoj osudi.
(2) Zaštitni nadzor prestaje opozivanjem uslovne osude.
(3) U toku trajanja zaštitnog nadzora sud može, s obzirom na ostvarene rezultate, pojedine obaveze ukinuti ili zamijeniti drugim.
(4) Ako u toku trajanja zaštitnog nadzora sud utvrdi da je ispunjena svrha ove mjere, može zaštitni nadzor ukinuti prije isteka određenog vremena.
Posljedice neispunjavanja obaveze zaštitnog nadzora
translated_text:
Article 63

(1) The duration of protective supervision measures is determined within the probationary period established in the suspended sentence.
(2) Protective supervision ceases upon revocation of the suspended sentence.
(3) During the duration of protective supervision, the court may, having regard to the results achieved, revoke individual obligations or replace them with others.
(4) If during the duration of protective supervision the court determines that the purpose of this measure has been fulfilled, it may revoke the protective supervision before the expiry of the specified time.
Consequences of non-fulfilment of protective supervision obligations

heading: Article 64
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 64

Ako osuđeni kome je izrečen zaštitni nadzor ne ispunjava obaveze koje mu je sud odredio, sud ga može opomenuti ili može ranije obaveze zamijeniti drugim ili produžiti trajanje zaštitnog nadzora u okviru vremena provjeravanja ili opozvati uslovnu osudu.
Sudska opomena
translated_text:
Article 64

If a convicted person to whom protective supervision has been imposed does not fulfil the obligations that the court has ordered, the court may warn him or may replace the previous obligations with others or extend the duration of protective supervision within the probationary period or revoke the suspended sentence.
Judicial warning

heading: Article 65
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 65

(1) Sudska opomena može se izreći za krivična djela za koja je propisan zatvor do jedne godine ili novčana kazna, a učinjena su pod takvim olakšavajućim okolnostima koje ih čine naročito lakim.
(2) Za određena krivična djela i pod uslovima predviđenim zakonom sudska opomena može se izreći i kad je propisan zatvor do tri godine.
(3) Sudsku opomenu sud može izreći za više krivičnih djela učinjenih u sticaju, ako za svako od tih djela postoje uslovi iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana.
(4) Pri odlučivanju da li će izreći sudsku opomenu sud će, vodeći računa o svrsi sudske opomene, posebno uzeti u obzir ličnost učinioca, njegov raniji život, njegovo ponašanje poslije izvršenja krivičnog djela, a naročito njegov odnos prema žrtvi krivičnog djela, stepen krivice i druge okolnosti pod kojima je djelo učinjeno.
(5) Sudska opomena ne može se izreći vojnim licima za krivična djela protiv Vojske Crne Gore.
GLAVA PETA
MJERE BEZBJEDNOSTI
Svrha mjera bezbjednosti
translated_text:
Article 65

(1) A judicial admonition may be pronounced for criminal offences punishable by imprisonment of up to one year or a fine, committed under such mitigating circumstances that make them particularly minor.
(2) For certain criminal offences and under conditions provided by law, a judicial admonition may be pronounced even when imprisonment of up to three years is prescribed.
(3) A judicial admonition may be pronounced by the court for multiple criminal offences committed in concurrence, if the conditions from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article exist for each of those offences.
(4) When deciding whether to pronounce a judicial admonition, the court shall, taking into account the purpose of the judicial admonition, particularly consider the personality of the perpetrator, his previous life, his conduct after the commission of the criminal offence, and especially his relationship towards the victim of the criminal offence, the degree of guilt and other circumstances under which the offence was committed.
(5) A judicial admonition may not be pronounced to military persons for criminal offences against the Army of Montenegro.
CHAPTER FIVE
SECURITY MEASURES
Purpose of security measures

heading: Article 66
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 66

U okviru opšte svrhe krivičnih sankcija (
translated_text:
Article 66

Within the general purpose of criminal sanctions (

heading: Article 4
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
član 4

stav 2) , svrha mjera bezbjednosti je da se otklone stanja ili uslovi koji mogu biti od uticaja da učinilac ubuduće vrši krivična dj ela.
Vrste mjera bezbjednosti
translated_text:
Article 4

paragraph 2), the purpose of security measures is to eliminate conditions or circumstances that may influence the perpetrator to commit criminal offences in the future.
Types of security measures

heading: Article 67
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex

heading: Article 68
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 68

(1) Sud može učiniocu krivičnog djela izreći jednu ili više mjera bezbjednosti kad postoje uslovi za njihovo izricanje predviđeni ovim zakonikom.
(2) Obavezno prihijatrijsko liječenje i čuvanje u zdravstvenoj ustanovi i obavezno psihijatrijsko liječenje na slobodi neuračunljivom učiniocu izriču se samostalno. Uz ove mjere mogu se izreći zabrana vršenja poziva, djelatnosti i dužnosti, zabrana upravljanja motornim vozilom i oduzimanje predmeta.
(3) Mjere iz stava 2 ovog člana mogu se izreći učiniocu krivičnog djela čija je uračunljivost bitno smanjena, ako mu je izrečena kazna ili uslovna osuda.
(4) Obavezno liječenje narkomana, obavezno liječenje alkoholičara, zabrana vršenja poziva, djelatnosti i dužnosti, zabrana upravljanja motornim vozilom, oduzimanje predmeta i javno objavljivanje presude mogu se izreći ako je učinocu izrečena kazna, uslovna osuda, sudska opomena ili je učinilac oslobođen od kazne.
(5) Protjerivanje stranca iz zemlje može se izreći ako je učiniocu izrečena kazna ili uslovna osuda.
(6) Zabrana približavanja i udaljenje iz stana ili drugog prostora za stanovanje mogu se izreći ako je učiniocu izrečena kazna zatvora ili novčana kazna.
(7) Za krivična djela u sticaju mjera bezbjednosti će se izreći ako je utvrđena za jedno od krivičnih djela u sticaju.
Obavezno psihijatrijsko liječenje i čuvanje u zdravstvenoj ustanovi
translated_text:
Article 68

(1) The court may pronounce to the perpetrator of a criminal offence one or more security measures when the conditions for their pronouncement provided by this Code exist.
(2) Mandatory psychiatric treatment and custody in a health institution and mandatory psychiatric treatment at liberty are pronounced independently to an insane perpetrator. Along with these measures, prohibition of performing a profession, activity and duty, prohibition of driving a motor vehicle and confiscation of objects may be pronounced.
(3) The measures from paragraph 2 of this Article may be pronounced to a perpetrator of a criminal offence whose sanity is substantially diminished, if a sentence or suspended sentence has been pronounced to him.
(4) Mandatory treatment of drug addicts, mandatory treatment of alcoholics, prohibition of performing a profession, activity and duty, prohibition of driving a motor vehicle, confiscation of objects and public announcement of the judgment may be pronounced if a sentence, suspended sentence, judicial admonition has been pronounced to the perpetrator or the perpetrator has been released from punishment.
(5) Expulsion of a foreigner from the country may be pronounced if a sentence or suspended sentence has been pronounced to the perpetrator.
(6) Prohibition of approach and removal from an apartment or other residential space may be pronounced if a sentence of imprisonment or a fine has been pronounced to the perpetrator.
(7) For criminal offences in concurrence, a security measure shall be pronounced if it has been established for one of the criminal offences in concurrence.
Mandatory psychiatric treatment and custody in a health institution

heading: Article 69
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 69

(1) Učiniocu koji je krivično djelo učinio u stanju bitno smanjene uračunljivosti sud će izreći obavezno psihijatrijsko liječenje i čuvanje u odgovarajućoj zdravstvenoj ustanovi, ako, s obzirom na učinjeno krivično djelo i stanje duševne poremećenosti, utvrdi da postoji ozbiljna opasnost da učinilac učini teže krivično djelo i da je radi otklanjanja ove opasnosti potrebno njegovo liječenje u takvoj ustanovi.
(2) Ako su ispunjeni uslovi iz stava 1 ovog člana, sud će izreći obavezno liječenje i čuvanje u zdravstvenoj ustanovi učiniocu koji je u stanju neuračunljivosti učinio protivpravno djelo predviđeno u zakonu kao krivično djelo.
(3) Mjeru iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana sud će obustaviti kad utvrdi da je prestala potreba za liječenjem i čuvanjem učinioca u zdravstvenoj ustanovi.
(4) Mjera iz stava 1 ovog člana izrečena uz kaznu zatvora može trajati i duže od izrečene kazne.
(5) Učiniocu koji je krivično djelo izvršio u stanju bitno smanjene uračunljivosti i koji je osuđen na kaznu zatvora, vrijeme provedeno u zdravstvenoj ustanovi uračunava se u vrijeme trajanja izrečene kazne. Ako je vrijeme provedeno u zdravstvenoj ustanovi kraće od trajanja izrečene kazne, sud će, po prestanku mjere bezbjednosti, odrediti da se osuđeni uputi na izdržavanje ostatka kazne ili da se pusti na uslovni otpust. Pri odlučivanju o puštanju na uslovni otpust sud će, pored uslova iz člana 37 ovog zakonika, naročito uzeti u obzir uspjeh liječenja osuđenog, njegovo zdravstveno stanje, vrijeme provedeno u zdravstvenoj ustanovi i ostatak kazne koju osuđeni nije izdržao.
Obavezno psihijatrijsko liječenje na slobodi
translated_text:
Article 69

(1) The court shall pronounce mandatory psychiatric treatment and custody in an appropriate health institution to a perpetrator who committed a criminal offence in a state of substantially diminished sanity, if, having regard to the committed criminal offence and the state of mental disorder, it establishes that there exists a serious danger that the perpetrator will commit a more serious criminal offence and that his treatment in such an institution is necessary to eliminate this danger.
(2) If the conditions from paragraph 1 of this Article are met, the court shall pronounce mandatory treatment and custody in a health institution to a perpetrator who in a state of insanity committed an unlawful act provided in law as a criminal offence.
(3) The court shall terminate the measure from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article when it establishes that the need for treatment and custody of the perpetrator in a health institution has ceased.
(4) The measure from paragraph 1 of this Article pronounced along with a sentence of imprisonment may last longer than the pronounced sentence.
(5) For a perpetrator who committed a criminal offence in a state of substantially diminished sanity and who has been sentenced to imprisonment, the time spent in a health institution shall be credited towards the duration of the pronounced sentence. If the time spent in a health institution is shorter than the duration of the pronounced sentence, the court shall, upon cessation of the security measure, order that the convicted person be sent to serve the remainder of the sentence or be released on parole. When deciding on release on parole, the court shall, in addition to the conditions from Article 37 of this Code, particularly take into account the success of the convicted person's treatment, his health condition, the time spent in the health institution and the remainder of the sentence that the convicted person has not served.
Mandatory psychiatric treatment at liberty

heading: Article 70
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 70

(1) Učiniocu koji je u stanju neuračunljivosti učinio protivpravno djelo određeno u zakonu kao krivično djelo, sud će izreći obavezno psihijatrijsko liječenje na slobodi, ako utvrdi da postoji ozbiljna opasnost da učinilac učini protivpravno djelo koje je u zakonu predviđeno kao krivično djelo i da je radi otklanjanja ove opasnosti dovoljno njegovo liječenje na slobodi.
(2) Mjera iz stava 1 ovog člana može se izreći i neuračunljivom učiniocu prema kojem je određeno obavezno psihijatrijsko liječenje i čuvanje u odgovarajućoj zdravstvenoj ustanovi kad sud, na osnovu rezultata liječenja, utvrdi da više nije potrebno njegovo čuvanje i liječenje u takvoj ustanovi, nego samo njegovo liječenje na slobodi.
(3) Pod uslovima iz stava 1 ovog člana sud može izreći obavezno psihijatrijsko liječenje na slobodi i učiniocu čija je uračunljivost bitno smanjena, ako mu je izrečena uslovna osuda ili je na osnovu člana 69 stav 5 ovog zakonika pušten na uslovni otpust.
(4) Obavezno psihijatrijsko liječenje na slobodi može se povremeno sprovoditi i u odgovarajućoj zdravstvenoj ustanovi, ako je to potrebno radi uspješnijeg liječenja, s tim da povremeno liječenje u ustanovi ne može neprekidno trajati duže od petnaest dana, niti ukupno duže od dva mj eseca.
(5) Obavezno psihijatrijsko liječenje na slobodi traje dok postoji potreba liječenja, ali ne duže od tri godine.
(6) Ako se u slučaju iz st. 1 do 3 ovog člana učinilac ne podvrgne liječenju na slobodi ili ga samovoljno napusti ili i pored liječenja nastupi opasnost da ponovo učini protivpravno djelo predviđeno u zakonu kao krivično djelo, tako da je potrebno njegovo liječenje i čuvanje u odgovarajućoj zdravstvenoj ustanovi, sud može izreći obavezno psihijatrijsko liječenje i čuvanje u takvoj ustanovi.
Obavezno liječenje narkomana
translated_text:
Article 70

(1) The court shall pronounce mandatory psychiatric treatment at liberty to a perpetrator who in a state of insanity committed an unlawful act defined in law as a criminal offence, if it establishes that there exists a serious danger that the perpetrator will commit an unlawful act provided in law as a criminal offence and that his treatment at liberty is sufficient to eliminate this danger.
(2) The measure from paragraph 1 of this Article may also be pronounced to an insane perpetrator for whom mandatory psychiatric treatment and custody in an appropriate health institution has been ordered, when the court, based on the results of treatment, establishes that his custody and treatment in such an institution is no longer necessary, but only his treatment at liberty.
(3) Under the conditions from paragraph 1 of this Article, the court may pronounce mandatory psychiatric treatment at liberty also to a perpetrator whose sanity is substantially diminished, if a suspended sentence has been pronounced to him or he has been released on parole pursuant to Article 69 paragraph 5 of this Code.
(4) Mandatory psychiatric treatment at liberty may be carried out periodically also in an appropriate health institution, if this is necessary for more successful treatment, provided that periodic treatment in the institution may not last continuously longer than fifteen days, nor in total longer than two months.
(5) Mandatory psychiatric treatment at liberty lasts as long as the need for treatment exists, but not longer than three years.
(6) If in the case from paragraphs 1 to 3 of this Article the perpetrator does not submit to treatment at liberty or arbitrarily abandons it, or despite treatment there arises a danger that he will again commit an unlawful act provided in law as a criminal offence, such that his treatment and custody in an appropriate health institution is necessary, the court may pronounce mandatory psychiatric treatment and custody in such an institution.
Mandatory treatment of drug addicts

heading: Article 71
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 71

(1) Učiniocu koji je učinio krivično djelo usljed zavisnosti od upotrebe opojnih droga i kod kojeg postoji ozbiljna opasnost da će usljed ove zavisnosti i dalje da vrši krivična djela, sud će izreći obavezno liječenje.
(2) Mjera iz stava 1 ovog člana izvršava se u ustanovi za izvršenje kazne ili u odgovarajućoj zdravstvenoj ili drugoj specijalizovanoj ustanovi i traje dok postoji potreba za liječenjem, ali ne duže od tri godine.
(3) Kad je mjera iz stava 1 ovog člana izrečena uz kaznu zatvora, ona može trajati duže od vremena izrečene kazne, ali njeno ukupno trajanje ne može biti duže od tri godine.
(4) Vrijeme provedeno u ustanovi za liječenje uračunava se u kaznu zatvora.
(5) Kad je mjera iz stava 1 ovog člana izrečena uz novčanu kaznu, uslovnu osudu, sudsku opomenu ili oslobođenje od kazne izvršava se na slobodi i ne može trajati duže od tri godine.
6) Ako se učinilac, bez opravdanih razloga, ne podvrgne liječenju na slobodi ili liječenje samovoljno napusti, sud će odrediti da se mjera prinudno izvrši u odgovarajućoj zdravstvenoj ili drugoj specijalizovanoj ustanovi.
Obavezno liječenje alkoholičara
translated_text:
Article 71

(1) The court shall pronounce mandatory treatment to a perpetrator who committed a criminal offence due to dependence on the use of narcotic drugs and in whom there exists a serious danger that he will continue to commit criminal offences due to this dependence.
(2) The measure from paragraph 1 of this Article is executed in an institution for execution of sentences or in an appropriate health or other specialized institution and lasts as long as the need for treatment exists, but not longer than three years.
(3) When the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article is pronounced along with a sentence of imprisonment, it may last longer than the time of the pronounced sentence, but its total duration may not be longer than three years.
(4) The time spent in the treatment institution is credited towards the sentence of imprisonment.
(5) When the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article is pronounced along with a fine, suspended sentence, judicial admonition or release from punishment, it is executed at liberty and may not last longer than three years.
6) If the perpetrator, without justified reasons, does not submit to treatment at liberty or arbitrarily abandons the treatment, the court shall order that the measure be forcibly executed in an appropriate health or other specialized institution.
Mandatory treatment of alcoholics

heading: Article 72
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 72

(1) Učiniocu koji je učinio krivično djelo usljed zavisnosti od upotrebe alkohola i kod kojeg postoji ozbiljna opasnost da će usljed ove zavisnosti i dalje da vrši krivična djela, sud će izreći obavezno liječenje.
(2) Mjera iz stava 1 ovog člana izvršava se u ustanovi za izvršenje kazne zatvora ili u odgovarajućoj zdravstvenoj ili drugoj specijalizovanoj ustanovi i traje dok postoji potreba za liječenjem, ali ne duže od izrečene kazne zatvora.
(3) Vrijeme provedeno u ustanovi za liječenje uračunava se u kaznu zatvora.
(4) Kad je mjera iz stava 1 ovog člana izrečena uz novčanu kaznu, uslovnu osudu, sudsku opomenu ili oslobođenje od kazne izvršava se na slobodi i ne može trajati duže od dvije godine.
(5) Ako se učinilac, bez opravdanih razloga, ne podvrgne liječenju na slobodi ili liječenje samovoljno napusti, sud će odrediti da se mjera prinudno izvrši u odgovarajućoj zdravstvenoj ili drugoj specijalizovanoj ustanovi.
Zabrana vršenja poziva, djelatnosti i dužnosti
translated_text:
Article 72

(1) The court shall impose mandatory treatment on a perpetrator who has committed a criminal offense due to dependence on the use of alcohol and in whom there exists a serious danger that he will continue to commit criminal offenses due to this dependence.
(2) The measure from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be executed in an institution for the execution of imprisonment or in an appropriate health or other specialized institution and shall last as long as there is a need for treatment, but not longer than the imposed prison sentence.
(3) Time spent in a treatment institution shall be credited toward the prison sentence.
(4) When the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article is imposed together with a fine, suspended sentence, judicial admonition or release from punishment, it shall be executed at liberty and may not last longer than two years.
(5) If the perpetrator, without justified reasons, does not undergo treatment at liberty or arbitrarily abandons treatment, the court shall order that the measure be forcibly executed in an appropriate health or other specialized institution.
Prohibition of Exercising a Profession, Activity and Duty

heading: Article 73
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 73

(1) Sud može učiniocu krivičnog djela zabraniti vršenje određenog poziva, određene djelatnosti ili svih ili nekih dužnosti vezanih za raspolaganje, korišćenje, upravljanje ili rukovanje tuđom imovinom ili za čuvanje te imovine, ako se opravdano može smatrati da bi njegovo dalje vršenje takve djelatnosti bilo opasno.
(2) Sud određuje trajanje mjere iz stava 1 ovog člana, koje ne može biti kraće od jedne niti duže od deset godina, računajući od dana pravosnažnosti odluke, s tim da se vrijeme provedeno u zatvoru, odnosno u zdravstvenoj ustanovi u kojoj je izvršena mjera bezbjednosti ne uračunava u vrijeme trajanja ove mjere.
(3) Ako izrekne uslovnu osudu, sud može odrediti da će se ta osuda opozvati, ako učinilac prekrši zabranu vršenja poziva, djelatnosti ili dužnosti.
Zabrana upravljanja motornim vozilom
translated_text:
Article 73

(1) The court may prohibit the perpetrator of a criminal offense from exercising a certain profession, certain activity or all or some duties related to disposing of, using, managing or handling another's property or to safeguarding such property, if it can be justifiably considered that his further exercise of such activity would be dangerous.
(2) The court shall determine the duration of the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article, which may not be shorter than one nor longer than ten years, counting from the day the decision becomes final, with the proviso that time spent in detention, that is, in a health institution in which a security measure was executed, shall not be credited toward the duration of this measure.
(3) If it imposes a suspended sentence, the court may order that the sentence shall be revoked if the perpetrator violates the prohibition of exercising a profession, activity or duty.
Prohibition of Driving a Motor Vehicle

heading: Article 74
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 74

(1) Učiniocu krivičnog djela kojim se ugrožava javni saobraća jsud može izreći zabranu upravljanja motornim vozilom.
(2) Pri izricanju mjere iz stava 1 ovog člana sud određuje na koje se vrste i kategorije vozila zabrana odnosi.
(3) Mjeru iz stava 1 ovog člana sud može izreći, ako nađe da težina učinjenog djela, okolnosti pod kojima je djelo učinjeno ili ranije kršenje saobraćajnih propisa od strane učinioca pokazuju da je opasno da on upravlja motornim vozilom određene vrste ili kategorije.
(4) Sud određuje trajanje mjere iz stava 1 ovog člana, koje ne može biti kraće od tri mjeseca niti duže od pet godina, računajući od dana pravosnažnosti odluke, s tim da se vrijeme provedeno u zatvoru, odnosno u ustanovi u kojoj se izvršava mjera bezbjednosti ili vaspitna mjera ne uračunava u vrijeme trajanja ove mjere.
(5) Učiniocu krivičnog djela kojim se ugrožava javni saobraćaj koje je za posljedicu imalo smrt jednog ili više lica, sud može izreći mjeru iz stava 1 ovog člana bez vremenskog ograničenja (trajno) ako mu je već bila izricana ova mjera bezbjednosti.
(6) Ako je mjera iz stava 1 ovog člana izrečena licu koje ima stranu dozvolu za upravljanje motornim vozilom, zabrana se odnosi na upravljanje motornim vozilom na teritoriji Crne Gore.
(7) Ako izrekne uslovnu osudu, sud može odrediti da će se ta osuda opozvati, ako učinilac prekrši zabranu upravljanja motornim vozilom.
(8) Zakonom se može odrediti obavezna zabrana upravljanja motornim vozilom.
Oduzimanje predmeta
translated_text:
Article 74

(1) The court may impose a prohibition of driving a motor vehicle on the perpetrator of a criminal offense that endangers public traffic.
(2) When imposing the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article, the court shall determine which types and categories of vehicles the prohibition applies to.
(3) The court may impose the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article if it finds that the gravity of the committed offense, the circumstances under which the offense was committed or previous violations of traffic regulations by the perpetrator show that it is dangerous for him to drive a motor vehicle of a certain type or category.
(4) The court shall determine the duration of the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article, which may not be shorter than three months nor longer than five years, counting from the day the decision becomes final, with the proviso that time spent in detention, that is, in an institution in which a security measure or educational measure is executed, shall not be credited toward the duration of this measure.
(5) The court may impose the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article without time limitation (permanently) on the perpetrator of a criminal offense that endangers public traffic which resulted in the death of one or more persons, if this security measure had already been imposed on him.
(6) If the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article is imposed on a person who has a foreign license to drive a motor vehicle, the prohibition applies to driving a motor vehicle on the territory of Montenegro.
(7) If it imposes a suspended sentence, the court may order that the sentence shall be revoked if the perpetrator violates the prohibition of driving a motor vehicle.
(8) The law may prescribe a mandatory prohibition of driving a motor vehicle.
Confiscation of Objects

heading: Article 75
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 75

(1) Predmeti koji su upotrijebljeni ili su bili namijenjeni za izvršenje krivičnog djela ili koji su nastali izvršenjem krivičnog djela mogu se oduzeti, ako su svojina učinioca.
(2) Predmeti iz stava 1 ovog člana mogu se oduzeti i kad nijesu svojina učinioca, ako to zahtijevaju razlozi bezbjednosti ljudi ili imovine ili razlozi morala ili kada i dalje postoji opasnost da će biti upotrijebljeni za izvršenje krivičnog djela, a time se ne dira u pravo trećih lica na naknadu štete od učinioca.
(3) Zakonom se može odrediti obavezno oduzimanje predmeta i uslovi za njihovo oduzimanje.
(4) Zakonom se može odrediti obavezno uništavanje oduzetih predmeta.
Protjerivanje stranca iz zemlje
translated_text:
Article 75

(1) Objects that were used or were intended for the commission of a criminal offense or that were created by the commission of a criminal offense may be confiscated if they are the property of the perpetrator.
(2) Objects from paragraph 1 of this Article may be confiscated even when they are not the property of the perpetrator, if required by reasons of safety of people or property or reasons of morality or when there still exists a danger that they will be used for the commission of a criminal offense, without prejudice to the right of third parties to compensation for damage from the perpetrator.
(3) The law may prescribe mandatory confiscation of objects and conditions for their confiscation.
(4) The law may prescribe mandatory destruction of confiscated objects.
Expulsion of a Foreigner from the Country

heading: Article 76
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 76

(1) Sud može stranca koji je učinio krivično djelo protjerati sa teritorije Crne Gore za vrijeme od jedne do deset godina ili zauvijek, ako je krivično djelo učinio u povratu (
translated_text:
Article 76

(1) The court may expel from the territory of Montenegro a foreigner who has committed a criminal offense for a period from one to ten years or permanently, if the criminal offense was committed in recidivism (

heading: Article 43)
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
član 43)

(2) Pri ocjeni da li će izreći mjeru iz stava 1 ovog člana sud će uzeti u obzir prirodu i težinu učinjenog krivičnog djela, pobude zbog kojih je krivično djelo učinjeno, način izvršenja krivičnog djela i druge okolnosti koje ukazuju na nepoželjnost daljeg boravka stranca u Crnoj Gori.
(3) Vrijeme trajanja protjerivanja računa se od dana pravosnažnosti odluke, s tim da se vrijeme provedeno u zatvoru ne uračunava u vrijeme trajanja ove mjere.
(4) Mjera iz stava 1 ovog člana ne može se izreći učiniocu koji bi u zemlji u koju bi bio protjeran mogao biti izložen mučenju ili nečovječnom ili ponižavajućem postupanju ili koji uživa drugu zaštitu u skladu sa potvrđenim međunarodnim ugovorima.
Javno objavljivanje presude
translated_text:
Article 43)

(2) When assessing whether to impose the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article, the court shall take into account the nature and gravity of the committed criminal offense, the motives for which the criminal offense was committed, the manner of commission of the criminal offense and other circumstances indicating the undesirability of the foreigner's further stay in Montenegro.
(3) The duration of expulsion shall be counted from the day the decision becomes final, with the proviso that time spent in detention shall not be credited toward the duration of this measure.
(4) The measure from paragraph 1 of this Article may not be imposed on a perpetrator who could be subjected to torture or inhuman or degrading treatment in the country to which he would be expelled or who enjoys other protection in accordance with ratified international treaties.
Public Announcement of the Judgment

heading: Article 77
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 77

(1) Pri osudi za krivično djelo učinjeno putem medija ili za krivično djelo koje je prouzrokovalo opasnost za život ili zdravlje ljudi a objavljivanje presude bi doprinijelo da se otkloni ili umanji ta opasno sud može odlučiti da se o trošku osuđenog istim putem ili na drugi odgovarajući način objavi sudska presuda u cjelini ili u izvodu.
(2) Zakonom se može odrediti obavezno objavljivanje presude. U tom slučaju sud će odlučiti putem kojeg medija će se presuda objaviti i da li će se objaviti u cjelini ili u izvodu.
(3) Javno objavljivanje presude izvršiće se najkasnije u roku od trideset dana od dana pravosnažnosti presude.
Zabrana približavanja
Član 77a
(1) Učiniocu krivičnog djela protiv polne slobode, krivičnog djela nasilje u porodici ili u porodičnoj zajednici i krivičnog djela rodoskrvnjenje ili nekog drugog krivičnog djela kojim se ugrožava život ili tijelo nekog lica ili krivičnog djela neovlašćena proizvodnja, držanje i stavljanje u promet opojnih droga sud će izreći zabranu približavanja žrtvi ili drugom licu ili grupi lica ili određenom mjestu kad postoji opasnost da bi učinilac prema tim licima ili na tom mjestu mogao ponovo da izvrši isto ili istovrsno krivično djelo.
(2) Sud određuje trajanje mjere iz stava 1 ovog člana, koje ne može biti kraće od jedne niti duže od pet godina, računajući od dana pravosnažnosti odluke, s tim da se vrijeme provedeno u zatvoru ne uračunava u vrijeme trajanja ove mjere.
(3) Po proteku jedne godine od početka izvršenja mjere iz stava 1 ovog člana, sud može, na predlog osuđenog lica, obustaviti njeno izvršenje ako utvrdi da više ne postoji opasnost iz stava 1 ovog člana.
(4) Sud će o pravosnažno izrečenoj mjeri iz stava 1 ovog člana obavijestiti posebnu organizacionu jedinicu ministarstva nadležnog za poslove pravosuđa koja vrši nadzor nad sprovođenjem uslovnog otpusta.
Udaljenje iz stana ili drugog prostora za stanovanje
Član 77b
(1) Učiniocu krivičnog djela nasilja u porodici ili u porodičnoj zajednici sud će izreći udaljenje iz stana ili drugog prostora za stanovanje ako postoji opasnost da bi učinilac mogao ponovo izvršiti to krivično djelo.
(2) Sud određuje trajanje mjere iz stava 1 ovog člana, koje ne može biti kraće od tri mjeseca niti duže od tri godine, računajući od dana pravosnažnosti odluke, s tim da se vrijeme provedeno u zatvoru ne uračunava u vrijeme trajanja ove mjere.
(3) Lice kome je izrečena mjera iz stava 1 ovog člana dužno je, u prisustvu policijskog službenika odmah po pravosnažnosti presude, da napusti stan ili neki drugi stambeni prostor koji čini zajedničko domaćinstvo.
(4) Po proteku šest mjeseci od početka izvršenja mjere iz stave 1 ovoga člana, sud može, na predlog osuđenog lica, obustaviti njeno izvršenje ako utvrdi da više ne postoji opasnost iz stava 1 ovog člana.
(5) Sud će o pravosnažno izrečenoj mjeri iz stava 1 ovog člana obavijestiti posebnu organizacionu jedinicu ministarstva nadležnog za poslove pravosuđa koja vrši nadzor nad sprovođenjem uslovnog otpusta i organ uprave nadležan za poslove policije.
Prestanak mjere bezbjednosti na osnovu sudske odluke
translated_text:
Article 77

(1) Upon conviction for a criminal offence committed through the media or for a criminal offence that has caused danger to the life or health of people, and if publication of the judgment would contribute to removing or reducing that danger, the court may decide that the court judgment be published in whole or in extract, at the expense of the convicted person, through the same medium or in another appropriate manner.
(2) The law may prescribe mandatory publication of the judgment. In that case, the court shall decide through which media the judgment will be published and whether it will be published in whole or in extract.
(3) Public publication of the judgment shall be carried out no later than within thirty days from the day the judgment becomes final.
Prohibition of approach
Article 77a
(1) The court shall impose a prohibition of approach to the victim or another person or group of persons or a specific place on the perpetrator of a criminal offence against sexual freedom, a criminal offence of domestic violence or violence in a family community and a criminal offence of incest or some other criminal offence that endangers the life or body of a person or a criminal offence of unauthorised production, possession and placing on the market of narcotic drugs, when there is a danger that the perpetrator might commit the same or similar criminal offence again towards those persons or at that place.
(2) The court shall determine the duration of the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article, which may not be shorter than one year nor longer than five years, counting from the day the decision becomes final, provided that time spent in detention shall not be counted towards the duration of this measure.
(3) After one year has elapsed from the commencement of execution of the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article, the court may, upon proposal of the convicted person, suspend its execution if it determines that the danger from paragraph 1 of this Article no longer exists.
(4) The court shall notify the special organisational unit of the ministry responsible for judicial affairs that supervises the implementation of conditional release about the final measure imposed under paragraph 1 of this Article.
Removal from apartment or other residential premises
Article 77b
(1) The court shall impose removal from an apartment or other residential premises on the perpetrator of a criminal offence of domestic violence or violence in a family community if there is a danger that the perpetrator might commit that criminal offence again.
(2) The court shall determine the duration of the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article, which may not be shorter than three months nor longer than three years, counting from the day the decision becomes final, provided that time spent in detention shall not be counted towards the duration of this measure.
(3) The person on whom the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article has been imposed is obliged, in the presence of a police officer, immediately upon the judgment becoming final, to leave the apartment or some other residential premises that constitutes a joint household.
(4) After six months have elapsed from the commencement of execution of the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article, the court may, upon proposal of the convicted person, suspend its execution if it determines that the danger from paragraph 1 of this Article no longer exists.
(5) The court shall notify the special organisational unit of the ministry responsible for judicial affairs that supervises the implementation of conditional release and the administrative authority responsible for police affairs about the final measure imposed under paragraph 1 of this Article.
Termination of security measure based on court decision

heading: Article 78
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 78

(1) Sud može odlučiti da prestanu mjere bezbjednosti zabrane vršenja poziva, djelatnosti ili dužnosti i zabrane upravljanja motornim vozilom, ako su protekle tri godine od dana njihovog primjenjivanja.
(2) Pri ocjeni da li će odrediti prestanak mjere bezbjednosti iz stava 1 ovog člana sud će uzeti u obzir ponašanje osuđenog poslije osude, da li je naknadio štetu prouzrokovanu krivičnim djelom, da li je vratio imovinsku korist stečenu izvršenjem krivičnog djela i druge okolnosti koje ukazuju na opravdanost prestanka tih mjera.
GLAVA ŠESTA
Čl. 79-111
(prestalo da važi)
GLAVA SEDMA
ODUZIMANjE IMOVINSKE KORISTI
Osnov oduzimanja imovinske koristi
translated_text:
Article 78

(1) The court may decide to terminate the security measures of prohibition of pursuing a calling, activity or duty and prohibition of driving a motor vehicle if three years have elapsed from the day of their application.
(2) When assessing whether to order termination of the security measure from paragraph 1 of this Article, the court shall take into account the behaviour of the convicted person after conviction, whether he has compensated for the damage caused by the criminal offence, whether he has returned the property benefit acquired by commission of the criminal offence and other circumstances indicating the justification for termination of those measures.
CHAPTER SIX
Arts. 79-111
(ceased to be in force)
CHAPTER SEVEN
CONFISCATION OF PROPERTY BENEFIT
Basis for confiscation of property benefit

heading: Article 112
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 112

(1) Niko ne može zadržati imovinsku korist pribavljenu protivpravnim djelom koje je u zakonu određeno kao krivično djelo.
(2) Korist iz stava 1 ovog člana oduzeće se, pod uslovima predviđenim ovim zakonikom i sudskom odlukom.
Uslovi i način oduzimanja imovinske koristi
translated_text:
Article 112

(1) No one may retain property benefit acquired by an unlawful act that is defined in law as a criminal offence.
(2) The benefit from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be confiscated under the conditions prescribed by this Code and by court decision.
Conditions and manner of confiscation of property benefit

heading: Article 113*
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 113*

(1) Od učinioca će se oduzeti novac, predmeti od vrijednosti i svaka druga imovinska korist koji su pribavljeni krivičnim djelom, a ako oduzimanje nije moguće učinilac će se obavezati da plati novčani iznos koji odgovara pribavljenoj imovinskoj koristi.
(2) Od učinioca krivičnog djela može se oduzeti i ona imovinska korist za koju postoji osnovana sumnja da je stečena kriminalnom djelatnošću, osim ako učinilac ne učini vjerovatnim da je njeno porijeklo zakonito (prošireno oduzimanje).
(3)
(prestalo da važi)
(4)
(prestalo da važi)
(5) Imovinska korist pribavljena krivičnim djelom oduzeće se i od lica na koje je prenesena bez naknade ili od lica koje je znalo da je imovinska korist pribavljena krivičnim djelom ili je to moglo i bilo dužno da zna.
(6) Ako je krivičnim djelom pribavljena imovinska korist za drugog ta korist će se oduzeti.
Zaštita oštećenog
translated_text:
Article 113*

(1) Money, objects of value and any other property benefit acquired by a criminal offence shall be confiscated from the perpetrator, and if confiscation is not possible, the perpetrator shall be obliged to pay a monetary amount corresponding to the acquired property benefit.
(2) Property benefit for which there is reasonable suspicion that it was acquired through criminal activity may also be confiscated from the perpetrator of a criminal offence, unless the perpetrator makes it probable that its origin is lawful (extended confiscation).
(3)
(ceased to be in force)
(4)
(ceased to be in force)
(5) Property benefit acquired by a criminal offence shall also be confiscated from a person to whom it was transferred without consideration or from a person who knew that the property benefit was acquired by a criminal offence or could and should have known it.
(6) If property benefit was acquired by a criminal offence for another person, that benefit shall be confiscated.
Protection of the injured party

heading: Article 114
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 114

(1) Ako je u krivičnom postupku usvojen imovinskopravni zahtjev oštećenog, sud će izreći oduzimanje imovinske koristi samo ukoliko ona prelazi dosuđeni imovinskopravni zahtjev oštećenog u tom iznosu.
(2) Oštećeni koji je u krivičnom postupku u pogledu svog imovinskopravnog zahtjeva upućen na parnicu može tražiti da se namiri iz oduzete imovinske koristi, ako pokrene parnicu u roku od šest mjeseci od dana pravosnažnosti odluke kojom je upućen na parnicu i ako u roku od tri meseca od dana pravosnažnosti odluke kojom je usvojen njegov imovinskopravni zahtjev zatraži namirenje iz oduzete imovinske koristi.
(3) Oštećeni koji u krivičnom postupku nije podnio imovinskopravni zahtjev može zahtijevati namirenje iz oduzete imovinske koristi, ako je radi utvrđivanja svog zahtjeva pokrenuo parnicu u roku od tri mjeseca od dana saznanja za presudu kojom je izrečeno oduzimanje imovinske koristi, a najdalje u roku od tri godine od dana pravosnažnosti odluke o oduzimanju imovinske koristi i ako u roku od tri mjeseca od dana pravosnažnosti odluke kojom je usvojen njegov imovinskopravni zahtjev zatraži namirenje iz oduzete imovinske koristi.
GLAVA OSMA
PRAVNE POSLjEDICE OSUDE
Nastupanje pravnih posljedica osude
translated_text:
Article 114

(1) If a property claim of the injured party has been granted in criminal proceedings, the court shall order confiscation of property benefit only insofar as it exceeds the granted property claim of the injured party in that amount.
(2) An injured party who has been referred to civil proceedings in criminal proceedings regarding his property claim may request to be satisfied from the confiscated property benefit if he initiates civil proceedings within six months from the day the decision referring him to civil proceedings becomes final and if within three months from the day the decision granting his property claim becomes final he requests satisfaction from the confiscated property benefit.
(3) An injured party who did not submit a property claim in criminal proceedings may request satisfaction from the confiscated property benefit if he initiated civil proceedings to establish his claim within three months from the day of learning of the judgment ordering confiscation of property benefit, and at the latest within three years from the day the decision on confiscation of property benefit becomes final, and if within three months from the day the decision granting his property claim becomes final he requests satisfaction from the confiscated property benefit.
CHAPTER EIGHT
LEGAL CONSEQUENCES OF CONVICTION
Occurrence of legal consequences of conviction

heading: Article 115
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 115

(1) Osude za određena krivična djela ili na određene kazne mogu imati za pravnu posljedicu prestanak, odnosno gubitak određenih prava ili zabranu sticanja određenih prava.
(2) Pravne posljedice osude ne mogu nastupiti kad je za krivično djelo učiniocu izrečena novčana kazna, uslovna osuda, ako ne bude opozvana, sudska opomena ili kad je učinilac oslobođen od kazne.
(3) Pravne posljedice osude mogu se predvidjeti samo zakonom i nastupaju po sili zakona kojim su predviđene.
Vrste pravnih posljedica osude
translated_text:
Article 115

(1) Convictions for certain criminal offences or to certain punishments may have as a legal consequence the termination or loss of certain rights or prohibition of acquisition of certain rights.
(2) Legal consequences of conviction cannot occur when a fine has been imposed on the perpetrator for a criminal offence, a suspended sentence, if it is not revoked, a judicial admonition, or when the perpetrator has been released from punishment.
(3) Legal consequences of conviction may be prescribed only by law and occur by force of the law by which they are prescribed.
Types of legal consequences of conviction

heading: Article 116
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex

heading: Article 117
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 117

(1) Pravne posljedice osude nastupaju danom pravosnažnosti presude.
(2) U slučaju da posle pravosnažnosti presude, na osnovu koje su nastupile pravne posljedice osude, ta presuda bude izmijenjena po vanrednom pravnom lijeku, nastupanje ili dalje trajanje pravnih posljedica osude usklađuje se sa novom odlukom.
(3) Pravne posljedice osude koje se sastoje u zabrani sticanja određenih prava mogu se propisati u trajanju najduže do deset godina.
(4) Vrijeme provedeno na izdržavanju kazne ne uračunava se u vrijeme trajanja pravne posljedice osude.
(5) Rehabilitacijom prestaju pravne posljedice osude predviđene u članu 116 stav 2 ovog zakonika.
GLAVA DEVETA
REHABILITACIJA, PRESTANAK PRAVNIH POSLjEDICA OSUDE I DAVANjE PODATAKA IZ KAZNENE EVIDENCIJE
Opšti pojam rehabilitacije
translated_text:
Article 117

(1) The legal consequences of conviction take effect on the day the judgment becomes final.
(2) In the event that after the judgment becomes final, on the basis of which the legal consequences of conviction took effect, that judgment is modified by extraordinary legal remedy, the occurrence or further duration of the legal consequences of conviction shall be harmonized with the new decision.
(3) Legal consequences of conviction consisting of a prohibition on acquiring certain rights may be prescribed for a duration of up to ten years at most.
(4) Time spent serving a sentence shall not be counted in the duration of the legal consequence of conviction.
(5) Rehabilitation terminates the legal consequences of conviction provided for in Article 116 paragraph 2 of this Code.
CHAPTER NINE
REHABILITATION, TERMINATION OF LEGAL CONSEQUENCES OF CONVICTION AND PROVISION OF DATA FROM CRIMINAL RECORDS
General concept of rehabilitation

heading: Article 118
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 118

(1) Rehabilitacijom se briše osuda i prestaju sve njene pravne posljedice, a osuđeni se smatra neosuđivanim.
(2) Rehabilitacija nastaje ili na osnovu samog zakona (zakonska rehabilitacija) ili po molbi osuđenog lica na osnovu sudske odluke (sudska rehabilitacija) .
(3) Rehabilitacijom se ne dira u prava trećih lica koja se zasnivaju na osudi.
Zakonska rehabilitacija
translated_text:
Article 118

(1) By rehabilitation the conviction is erased and all its legal consequences cease, and the convicted person is considered not to have been convicted.
(2) Rehabilitation occurs either on the basis of the law itself (statutory rehabilitation) or upon application of the convicted person on the basis of a court decision (judicial rehabilitation).
(3) Rehabilitation does not affect the rights of third parties based on the conviction.
Statutory rehabilitation

heading: Article 119
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex

heading: Article 120
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 120

(1) Sudska rehabilitacija može se dati licu koje je osuđeno na kaznu zatvora preko jedne do dvije godine, ako u roku od pet godina od dana kad je ta kazna izdržana, zastarjela ili oproštena ne učini novo krivično djelo.
(2) Licu koje je osuđeno na kaznu zatvora preko dvije do tri godine sudska rehabilitacija može se dati ako u roku od osam godina od dana kad je ta kazna izdržana, zastarjela ili oproštena ne učini novo krivično djelo.
(3) U slučaju iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana sud će dati rehabilitaciju ako nađe da je osuđeno lice svojim vladanjem zaslužilo rehabilitaciju i ako je, prema svojim mogućnostima, naknadilo štetu prouzrokovanu krivičnim djelom, pri čemu je sud dužan da uzme u obzir i sve druge okolnosti od značaja za davanje rehabilitacije, a posebno prirodu i značaj dj ela.
(4) Sudska rehabilitacija ne može se dati ako sporedna kazna još nije izvršena ili ako još traju mjere bezbjednosti.
Sudska rehabilitacija lica koje je više puta osuđivano
translated_text:
Article 120

(1) Judicial rehabilitation may be granted to a person who has been sentenced to imprisonment over one year up to two years, if within five years from the day that sentence was served, became statute-barred or was pardoned, he does not commit a new criminal offense.
(2) To a person who has been sentenced to imprisonment over two years up to three years, judicial rehabilitation may be granted if within eight years from the day that sentence was served, became statute-barred or was pardoned, he does not commit a new criminal offense.
(3) In the cases referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, the court shall grant rehabilitation if it finds that the convicted person has by his conduct deserved rehabilitation and if he has, according to his abilities, compensated for the damage caused by the criminal offense, whereby the court is obliged to take into account all other circumstances relevant to granting rehabilitation, and in particular the nature and significance of the offense.
(4) Judicial rehabilitation cannot be granted if an accessory sentence has not yet been served or if security measures are still in effect.
Judicial rehabilitation of a person who has been convicted multiple times

heading: Article 121
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 121

Licu koje je više puta osuđivano sud može dati rehabilitaciju samo ako su ispunjeni uslovi iz čl. 119 i 120 ovog zakonika u pogledu svakog krivičnog djela za koje je osuđeno. Pri ocjeni da li će u ovakvom slučaju dati rehabilitaciju sud će uzeti u obzir okolnosti iz člana 120 stav 3 ovog zakonika.
Prestanak pravnih posljedica osude
translated_text:
Article 121

To a person who has been convicted multiple times, the court may grant rehabilitation only if the conditions from Articles 119 and 120 of this Code are met with respect to each criminal offense for which he was convicted. In assessing whether to grant rehabilitation in such a case, the court shall take into account the circumstances from Article 120 paragraph 3 of this Code.
Termination of legal consequences of conviction

heading: Article 122
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 122

(1) Kad proteknu tri godine od dana izdržane, zastarjele ili oproštene kazne, sud može odlučiti da prestane pravna posljedica osude koja se odnosi na zabranu sticanja određenog prava, ukoliko već nije prestala usljed rehabilitacije.
(2) Pri odlučivanju o prestanku pravne posljedice osude sud će uzeti u obzir ponašanje osuđenog poslije osude, da li je naknadio štetu prouzrokovanu krivičnim djelom i vratio imovinsku korist stečenu izvršenjem krivičnog djela, kao i druge okolnosti koje ukazuju na opravdanost prestanka pravne posljedice osude.
Davanje podataka iz kaznene evidnecije
translated_text:
Article 122

(1) When three years have elapsed from the day the sentence was served, became statute-barred or was pardoned, the court may decide that the legal consequence of conviction relating to the prohibition on acquiring a certain right shall cease, unless it has already ceased as a result of rehabilitation.
(2) In deciding on the termination of the legal consequence of conviction, the court shall take into account the conduct of the convicted person after the conviction, whether he has compensated for the damage caused by the criminal offense and returned the property benefit acquired by committing the criminal offense, as well as other circumstances indicating the justification for terminating the legal consequence of conviction.
Provision of data from criminal records

heading: Article 123
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 123

(1) Kaznena evidencija sadrži lične podatke o učiniocu krivičnog djela, podatke o krivičnom djelu, podatke o kazni, uslovnoj osudi, sudskoj opomeni, oslobađanju od kazne i oproštenoj kazni, kao i podatke o pravnim posljedicama osude. U kaznenu evidenciju se unose i kasnije izmjene podataka sadržanih u kaznenoj evidenciji, podaci o izdržavanju kazne, kao i poništenje evidencije o pogrešnoj osudi.
(2) Evidencija o vaspitnim mjerama sadrži sljedeće podatke: lične podatke o maloljetnim učiniocima, podaci o krivičnom djelu, podatke o vaspitnim mjerama koje su primijenjene i izvršene, kao i ostale podatke koji se odnose na primjenu vaspitnih mjera.
(3) Podaci iz kaznene evidencije mogu se dati samo sudu, državnom tužiocu i organu uprave nadležnom za poslove policije u vezi sa krivičnim postupkom koji se vodi protiv lica koje je ranije bilo osuđeno, organu za izvršenje krivičnih sankcija i organu koji učestuje u postupku davanja amnestije, pomilovanja, rehabilitacije ili odlučivanja o prestanku pravnih posljedica osude, kao i organima starateljstva, kad je to potrebno za vršenje poslova iz njihove nadležnosti.
(4) Podaci iz kaznene evidencije mogu se, na obrazložen zahtjev, dati i državnom organu, privrednom društvu, drugoj organizaciji ili preduzetniku, ako još traju pravne posljedice osude ili mjere bezbjednosti i ako za to postoji opravdani interes zasnovan na zakonu.
(5) Niko nema prava da traži od građanina da podnosi dokaz o svojoj osuđivanosti ili neosuđivanosti.
(6) Građanima se, na njihov zahtjev, mogu davati podaci o njihovoj osuđivanosti ili neosuđivanosti samo ako su im potrebni radi ostvarivanja njihovih prava u inostranstvu.
GLAVA DESETA
ZASTARJELOST
Zastarjelost krivičnog gonjenja
translated_text:
Article 123

(1) Criminal records contain personal data about the perpetrator of a criminal offense, data about the criminal offense, data about the sentence, suspended sentence, judicial admonition, release from punishment and pardoned sentence, as well as data about the legal consequences of conviction. Criminal records also include subsequent modifications of data contained in criminal records, data about serving the sentence, as well as annulment of records concerning wrongful conviction.
(2) Records of educational measures contain the following data: personal data about juvenile perpetrators, data about the criminal offense, data about educational measures that were applied and executed, as well as other data relating to the application of educational measures.
(3) Data from criminal records may be provided only to a court, state prosecutor and administrative body competent for police affairs in connection with criminal proceedings conducted against a person who was previously convicted, to a body for execution of criminal sanctions and a body participating in the procedure for granting amnesty, pardon, rehabilitation or deciding on the termination of legal consequences of conviction, as well as to guardianship authorities, when necessary for the performance of duties within their competence.
(4) Data from criminal records may, upon reasoned request, also be provided to a state body, business company, other organization or entrepreneur, if the legal consequences of conviction or security measures are still in effect and if there is a justified interest based on law.
(5) No one has the right to require a citizen to submit proof of his conviction or non-conviction.
(6) Citizens may, upon their request, be provided with data about their conviction or non-conviction only if they need it for the realization of their rights abroad.
CHAPTER TEN
STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS
Statute of limitations for criminal prosecution

heading: Article 124
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex

heading: Article 125
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 125

(1) Zastarijevanje krivičnog gonjenja počinje od dana kad je krivično djelo učinjeno. Ukoliko posljedica krivičnog djela nastupi kasnije, zastarijevanje krivičnog gonjenja počinje od dana kada je posljedica nastupila.
(2) Zastarijevanje ne teče za vrijeme za koje se po zakonu gonjenje ne može otpočeti ili nastaviti.
(3) Zastarijevanje krivičnog gonjenja za djelo učinjeno na štetu maloljetnog lica ne teče dok to lice ne navrši osamnaest godina.
(4) Zastarijevanje se prekida svakom procesnom radnjom koja se preduzima radi otkrivanja krivičnog djela ili radi otkrivanja i gonjenja učinioca zbog učinjenog krivičnog djela.
(5) Zastarijevanje se prekida i kad učinilac u vrijeme dok teče rok zastarjelosti učini isto tako teško ili teže krivičnog djelo.
(6) Svakim prekidom zastarijevanje počinje ponovo da teče.
(7) Zastarjelost krivičnog gonjenja nastaje u svakom slučaju kad protekne dvosturko vrijeme koje se po zakonu traži za zastarjelost krivičnog gonjenja.
Zastarjelost izvršenja kazne
translated_text:
Article 125

(1) The statute of limitations for criminal prosecution begins from the day the criminal offense was committed. If the consequence of the criminal offense occurs later, the statute of limitations for criminal prosecution begins from the day the consequence occurred.
(2) The statute of limitations does not run for the period during which, according to law, prosecution cannot be commenced or continued.
(3) The statute of limitations for criminal prosecution for an offense committed against a minor does not run until that person reaches eighteen years of age.
(4) The statute of limitations is interrupted by every procedural action undertaken for the purpose of discovering the criminal offense or for the purpose of discovering and prosecuting the perpetrator for the committed criminal offense.
(5) The statute of limitations is also interrupted when the perpetrator, during the limitation period, commits an equally serious or more serious criminal offense.
(6) With each interruption, the statute of limitations begins to run anew.
(7) The statute of limitations for criminal prosecution occurs in any case when double the time required by law for the statute of limitations for criminal prosecution has elapsed.
Statute of limitations for execution of sentence

heading: Article 126
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex

heading: Article 127
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 127

(1) Zastarjelost izvršenja novčane kazne kao sporedne kazne nastaje kad protekne dvije godine od dana pravosnažnosti presude kojom je ta kazna izrečena.
(2) Zastarjelost izvršenja mjere bezbjednosti obaveznog psihijatrijskog liječenja na slobodi, obaveznog liječenja narkomana, obaveznog liječenja alkoholičara i oduzimanja predmeta nastaje kad protekne pet godina od dana pravosnažnosti odluke kojom su te mjere izrečene.
(3) Zastarjelost izvršenja mjera bezbjednosti zabrane vršenja poziva, djelatnosti i dužnosti, zabrane upravljanja motornim vozilom i protjerivanja stranca iz zemlje nastaje kad protekne vrijeme za koje su te mjere izrečene.
(4) Izvršenje mjere bezbjednosti obaveznog psihijatrijskog liječenja i čuvanja u zdravstvenoj ustanovi ne zastarijeva, ali ako je od pravosnažnosti presude kojom je mjera bezbjednosti izrečena proteklo više od pet godina, a izvršenje nije započeto, sud će ispitati da li je izvršenje ove mjere još uvijek potrebno.
Tok i prekid zastarijevanja izvršenja kazne i mjere bezbjednosti
translated_text:
Article 127

(1) The statute of limitations for execution of a fine as an accessory sentence occurs when two years have elapsed from the day the judgment imposing that sentence became final.
(2) The statute of limitations for execution of the security measure of mandatory psychiatric treatment at liberty, mandatory treatment of drug addicts, mandatory treatment of alcoholics and confiscation of objects occurs when five years have elapsed from the day the decision imposing those measures became final.
(3) The statute of limitations for execution of the security measures of prohibition from pursuing a calling, activity and duty, prohibition from driving a motor vehicle and expulsion of a foreigner from the country occurs when the time for which those measures were imposed has elapsed.
(4) Execution of the security measure of mandatory psychiatric treatment and confinement in a health institution does not become statute-barred, but if more than five years have elapsed from the finality of the judgment imposing the security measure and execution has not commenced, the court shall examine whether execution of this measure is still necessary.
Running and interruption of the statute of limitations for execution of sentence and security measure

heading: Article 128
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 128

(1) Zastarijevanje izvršenja kazne počinje od dana kad je presuda kojom je kazna izrečena postala pravosnažna, a ako je uslovna osuda opozvana - od dana kad je odluka o opozivanju postala pravosnažna.
(2) Ako je aktom amnestije ili pomilovanja ili odlukom suda po vanrednom pravnom lijeku izrečena kazna smanjena, vrijeme potrebno za nastupanje zastarjelosti određuje se prema novoj kazni, ali se tok zastarjelosti računa od ranije pravosnažne presude.
(3) Zastarijevanje ne teče za vrijeme za koje se po zakonu izvršenje kazne ne može preduzeti.
(4) Zastarijevanje se prekida svakom radnjom nadležnog organa koja se preduzima radi izvršenja kazne.
(5) Svakim prekidom zastarijevanje počinje ponovo da teče.
(6) Zastarjelost izvršenja kazne nastaje u svakom slučaju kad protekne dvostruko vrijeme koje se po zakonu traži za zastarjelost izvršenja kazne.
(7) U slučaju nastupanja zastarjelosti iz stava 6 ovog člana započeto izvršenje kazne obustavlja se.
(8) Odredbe st. 2 do 5 ovog člana shodno se primjenjuju i na zastarjelost izvršenja mjere bezbjednosti.
Nezastarivost krivičnog gonjenja i izvršenja kazne
translated_text:
Article 128

(1) The statute of limitations for execution of a sentence begins from the day the judgment imposing the sentence became final, and if a suspended sentence was revoked - from the day the decision on revocation became final.
(2) If by an act of amnesty or pardon or by a court decision following an extraordinary legal remedy the imposed sentence was reduced, the time required for the statute of limitations to occur is determined according to the new sentence, but the running of the statute of limitations is calculated from the earlier final judgment.
(3) The statute of limitations does not run for the period during which, according to law, execution of the sentence cannot be undertaken.
(4) The statute of limitations is interrupted by every action of the competent authority undertaken for the purpose of executing the sentence.
(5) With each interruption, the statute of limitations begins to run anew.
(6) The statute of limitations for execution of a sentence occurs in any case when double the time required by law for the statute of limitations for execution of the sentence has elapsed.
(7) In case of occurrence of the statute of limitations under paragraph 6 of this article, commenced execution of the sentence shall be suspended.
(8) The provisions of paragraphs 2 to 5 of this article apply mutatis mutandis to the statute of limitations for execution of a security measure.
Non-applicability of statute of limitations for criminal prosecution and execution of sentence

heading: Article 129
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 129

Krivično gonjenje i izvršenje kazne ne zastarijevaju za krivična djela predviđena u čl. 264 do 276b, 401, 401a, 422 do 424 i 426 do 431 ovog zakonika, kao ni za krivična djela za koja po potvrđenim međunarodnim ugovorima zastarjelost ne može da nastupi.
GLAVA JEDANAESTA
AMNESTIJA I POMILOVANjE
Amnestija
translated_text:
Article 129

Criminal prosecution and execution of sentence do not become statute-barred for criminal offenses provided for in Articles 264 to 276b, 401, 401a, 422 to 424 and 426 to 431 of this code, nor for criminal offenses for which, according to ratified international treaties, the statute of limitations cannot occur.
CHAPTER ELEVEN
AMNESTY AND PARDON
Amnesty

heading: Article 130
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 130

(1) Licima koja su obuhvaćena aktom amnestije daje se oslobođenje od krivičnog gonjenja ili potpuno ili djelimično oslobođenje od izvršenja kazne, zamjenjuje se izrečena kazna blažom kaznom, daje se rehabilitacija ili se ukidaju pojedine ili sve pravne posljedice osude.
(2) Amnestijom se mogu ukinuti sljedeće mjere bezbjednosti: zabrana vršenja poziva, djelatnosti i dužnosti, zabrana upravljanja motornim vozilom i protjerivanje stranaca iz zemlje.
Pomilovanje
translated_text:
Article 130

(1) Persons covered by an act of amnesty are granted exemption from criminal prosecution or full or partial exemption from execution of sentence, the imposed sentence is replaced with a more lenient sentence, rehabilitation is granted, or individual or all legal consequences of conviction are abolished.
(2) By amnesty, the following security measures may be abolished: prohibition from pursuing a calling, activity and duty, prohibition from driving a motor vehicle and expulsion of foreigners from the country.
Pardon

heading: Article 131
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 131

(1) Pomilovanjem se poimenično određenom licu daje oslobođenje od krivičnog gonjenja ili potpuno ili djelimično oslobođenje od izvršenja kazne, zamjenjuje se izrečena kazna blažom kaznom ili uslovnom osudom, daje se rehabilitacija, određuje kraće trajanje određene pravne posljedice osude ili se ukidaju pojedine ili sve pravne posljedice osude.
(2) Pomilovanjem se može ukinuti ili odrediti kraće trajanje mjere bezbjednosti zabrana vršenja poziva, djelatnosti i dužnosti, zabrana upravljanja motornim vozilom i protjerivanje stranca iz zemlje.
Dejstvo amnestije i pomilovanja na prava trećih lica
translated_text:
Article 131

(1) By pardon, a specifically named person is granted exemption from criminal prosecution or full or partial exemption from execution of sentence, the imposed sentence is replaced with a more lenient sentence or with a suspended sentence, rehabilitation is granted, a shorter duration of a particular legal consequence of conviction is determined, or individual or all legal consequences of conviction are abolished.
(2) By pardon, the security measure of prohibition from pursuing a calling, activity and duty, prohibition from driving a motor vehicle and expulsion of a foreigner from the country may be abolished or a shorter duration may be determined.
Effect of amnesty and pardon on rights of third parties

heading: Article 132
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 132

Davanjem amnestije ili pomilovanja ne dira se u prava trećih lica koja se zasnivaju na osudi.
GLAVA DVANAESTA
VAŽENjE KRIVIČNOG ZAKONODAVSTVA CRNE GORE
Vremensko važenje krivičnog zakonodavstva
translated_text:
Article 132

The granting of amnesty or pardon does not affect the rights of third parties based on the conviction.
CHAPTER TWELVE
APPLICATION OF CRIMINAL LEGISLATION OF MONTENEGRO
Temporal application of criminal legislation

heading: Article 133
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 133

(1) Na učinioca krivičnog djela primjenjuje se zakon koji je važio u vrijeme izvršenja krivičnog djela.
(2) Ako je poslije izvršenja krivičnog djela izmijenjen zakon, jednom ili više puta, primijeniće se zakon koji je najblaži za učinioca.
(3) Na učinioca krivičnog djela koje je određeno zakonom sa određenim vremenskim trajanjem primjenjuje se taj zakon, bez obzira na to kad mu se sudi, ako tim zakonom nije drukčije određeno.
(4) Mjere bezbjednosti i vaspitne mjere propisane novim zakonom mogu se primijeniti na učinioca, ako nijesu za njega nepovoljnije od onih koje su se mogle primijeniti prema zakonu koji je važio u vrijeme izvršenja djela.
Važenje krivičnog zakonodavstva na teritoriji Crne Gore
translated_text:
Article 133

(1) The law that was in force at the time of commission of the criminal offense applies to the perpetrator of the criminal offense.
(2) If after commission of the criminal offense the law has been amended, once or several times, the law that is most lenient for the perpetrator shall apply.
(3) The law with a specified temporal duration applies to the perpetrator of a criminal offense defined by that law, regardless of when he is tried, unless otherwise provided by that law.
(4) Security measures and educational measures prescribed by the new law may be applied to the perpetrator if they are not more unfavorable for him than those that could have been applied under the law that was in force at the time of commission of the offense.
Application of criminal legislation on the territory of Montenegro

heading: Article 134
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 134

(1) Krivično zakonodavstvo Crne Gore važi za svakog ko na njenoj teritoriji učini krivično djelo.
(2) Krivično zakonodavstvo Crne Gore važi i za svakog ko učini krivično djelo na domaćem brodu, bez obzira gdje se brod nalazi u vrijeme izvršenja djela.
(3) Krivično zakonodavstvo Crne Gore važi i za svakog ko učini krivično djelo u domaćem civilnom vazduhoplovu ili u domaćem vojnom vazduhoplovu, bez obzira gdje se vazduhoplov nalazio u vrijeme izvršenja krivičnog djela.
Važenje krivičnog zakonodavstva Crne Gore za učinioce određenih krivičnih djela izvršenih u inostranstvu
translated_text:
Article 134

(1) The criminal legislation of Montenegro applies to anyone who commits a criminal offense on its territory.
(2) The criminal legislation of Montenegro also applies to anyone who commits a criminal offense on a domestic vessel, regardless of where the vessel is located at the time of commission of the offense.
(3) The criminal legislation of Montenegro also applies to anyone who commits a criminal offense in a domestic civil aircraft or in a domestic military aircraft, regardless of where the aircraft was located at the time of commission of the criminal offense.
Application of criminal legislation of Montenegro to perpetrators of certain criminal offenses committed abroad

heading: Article 135
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 135

Krivično zakonodavstvo Crne Gore važi za svakog ko u inostranstvu učini krivično djelo iz čl. 357 do 369, čl. 371 do 374 i čl. 447 do 449b ovog zakonika ili iz čl. 258 i 268 ovog zakonika, ako se falsifikovanje odnosi na novac koji je u vrijeme izvršenja krivičnog djela bio zakonsko sredstvo plaćanja u Crnoj Gori.
