Prosecution for Criminal Offences against Freedoms and Rights of Man and Citizen

heading: Article 183
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 183

Gonjenje za djelo iz čl. 169 stav 1, 172 st. 1 i 2, 173 st. 1 i 2, 174 stav 1, 175 stav 1, 176 st 1 i 2 i 177 stav 1 ovog zakonika preduzima se po privatnoj tužbi, osim kad je oštećeni lice iz člana 42a stav 2 ovog zakonika.
GLAVA ŠESNAESTA
KRIVIČNA DJELA PROTIV IZBORNIH PRAVA
Povreda prava kandidovanja
translated_text:
Article 183

Prosecution for the act from Art. 169 paragraph 1, 172 paragraphs 1 and 2, 173 paragraphs 1 and 2, 174 paragraph 1, 175 paragraph 1, 176 paragraphs 1 and 2 and 177 paragraph 1 of this Code shall be undertaken by private action, except when the injured party is a person from Article 42a paragraph 2 of this Code.
CHAPTER SIXTEEN
CRIMINAL OFFENCES AGAINST ELECTORAL RIGHTS
Violation of the Right to Candidacy

heading: Article 184
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 184

Ko kršenjem zakona ili na drugi protivpravan način spriječi ili ometa kandidovanje na izborima, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
Povreda prava glasanja
translated_text:
Article 184

Whoever by violation of the law or in another unlawful manner prevents or obstructs candidacy in elections, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
Violation of the Right to Vote

heading: Article 185
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 185

(1) Ko drugog u namjeri da mu onemogući vršenje prava glasanja, protivzakonito ne upiše u spisak glasača, izbriše iz tog spiska ili ga na drugi pritivpravan način spriječi ili omete da glasa, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
(2) Kaznom iz stava 1 ovog člana kazniće se i ko drugog, u namjeri da mu omogući glasanje, protivpravno upiše u spisak glasača ili mu na drugi protivpravan način omogući da glasa iako na to nema pravo.
Povreda slobode opredjeljenja pri glasanju
translated_text:
Article 185

(1) Whoever, with the intention to prevent another from exercising the right to vote, unlawfully fails to register them in the voter list, deletes them from that list or in another unlawful manner prevents or obstructs them from voting, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1 of this Article shall also be imposed on whoever, with the intention to enable another to vote, unlawfully registers them in the voter list or in another unlawful manner enables them to vote although they have no right to do so.
Violation of Freedom of Choice in Voting

heading: Article 186
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 186

(1) Ko silom ili prijetnjom prinudi drugog ili na drugi protivpravan način na njega utiče da na izborima ili na referendumu vrši ili ne vrši pravo glasanja ili da glasa za ili protiv određenog kandidata, izborne liste odnosno predloga, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do tri godine.
(2) Kaznom iz stava 1 ovog člana kazniće se ko zahtijeva ili primi poklon ili drugu korist ili prihvati obećanje poklona ili druge koristi za sebe ili drugoga da glasa ili ne glasa ili da glasa u korist ili protiv određenog lica.
(3) Prihvaćeni poklon ili druga korist oduzeće se.
(4) Ako djelo iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana učini član biračkog odbora ili drugo lice u vršenju dužnosti u vezi sa glasanjem, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do pet godina.
(5) Ko poslije obavljenih izbora ili na referendumu, pozove glasača na odgovornost u vezi sa glasanjem ili zahtijeva od njega da kaže kako je glasao ili zašto je glasao ili nije glasao, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
Zloupotreba prava glasanja
translated_text:
Article 186

(1) Whoever by force or threat compels another or in another unlawful manner influences them to exercise or not exercise the right to vote in elections or in a referendum or to vote for or against a particular candidate, electoral list or proposal, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to three years.
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever requests or receives a gift or other benefit or accepts a promise of a gift or other benefit for themselves or another to vote or not vote or to vote in favour of or against a particular person.
(3) The accepted gift or other benefit shall be confiscated.
(4) If the act from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article is committed by a member of an electoral board or another person in the performance of duties related to voting, they shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years.
(5) Whoever, after elections have been held or in a referendum, calls a voter to account in relation to voting or demands that they say how they voted or why they voted or did not vote, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
Abuse of the Right to Vote

heading: Article 187
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 187

(1) Ko na izborima ili na referendumu glasa umjesto drugog lica pod njegovim imenom ili na istom glasanju glasa više od jedanput ili koristi više od jednog glasačkog listića, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
(2) Član biračkog odbora koji omogući drugome da izvrši djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do dvije godine.
Sastavljanje netačnih biračkih spiskova
translated_text:
Article 187

(1) Whoever in elections or in a referendum votes instead of another person under their name or votes more than once in the same voting or uses more than one ballot paper, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
(2) A member of an electoral board who enables another to commit the act from paragraph 1 of this Article, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to two years.
Compiling Inaccurate Voter Lists

heading: Article 188
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 188

Ko u namjeri uticanja na rezultate izbora ili na referendumu, sačini netačan birački spisak, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do tri godine.
Sprječavanje održavanja glasanja
translated_text:
Article 188

Whoever, with the intention of influencing the results of elections or in a referendum, compiles an inaccurate voter list, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to three years.
Preventing the Holding of Voting

heading: Article 189
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 189

(1) Ko silom, prijetnjom ili na drugi protivpravan način spriječi ili ometa održavanje glasanja na biračkom mjestu, kazniće se zatvorom do tri godine.
(2) Ko ometa glasanje izazivanjem nereda na biračkom mjestu usljed čega glasanje bude prekinuto, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do dvije godine.
Sprječavanje praćenja glasanja
translated_text:
Article 189

(1) Whoever by force, threat or in another unlawful manner prevents or obstructs the holding of voting at a polling station, shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.
(2) Whoever obstructs voting by causing disorder at a polling station as a result of which voting is interrupted, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to two years.
Preventing the Monitoring of Voting

heading: Article 190
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 190

Član organa za sprovođenje izbora koji spriječi ili ometa praćenje toka glasanja ili utvrđivanja rezultata glasanja licu koje na to ima pravo po zakonu ili na osnovu odluke nadležnog državnog organa, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
Povreda tajnosti glasanja
translated_text:
Article 190

A member of an electoral administration body who prevents or obstructs the monitoring of the course of voting or the determination of voting results by a person who has that right under the law or based on a decision of a competent state authority, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
Violation of Voting Secrecy

heading: Article 191
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 191

(1) Ko na izborima ili referendumu povrijedi tajnost glasanja, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do šest mjeseci.
(2) Ako djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učini član biračkog odbora ili drugo lice u vršenju dužnosti u vezi sa glasanjem, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do dvije godine.
Falsifikovanje rezultata glasanja
translated_text:
Article 191

(1) Whoever in elections or a referendum violates the secrecy of voting, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to six months.
(2) If the act from paragraph 1 of this Article is committed by a member of an electoral board or another person in the performance of duties related to voting, they shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to two years.
Falsification of Voting Results

heading: Article 192
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 192

Član organa za sprovođenje izbora ili referenduma ili drugo lice koje vrši dužnosti u vezi sa glasanjem, koji dodavanjem ili oduzimanjem glasačkih listića ili glasova pri prebrojavanju ili na drugi način izmijeni broj glasačkih listića ili glasova ili objavi neistinit rezultat glasanja, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do tri godine.
Uništavanje dokumenata o glasanju
translated_text:
Article 192

A member of an electoral administration body for conducting elections or a referendum or another person performing duties related to voting, who by adding or removing ballot papers or votes during counting or in another manner alters the number of ballot papers or votes or announces an untrue voting result, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to three years.
Destruction of Voting Documents

heading: Article 193
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 193

(1) Ko uništi, ošteti, oduzme ili prikrije glasački listić ili neki drugi dokument o glasanju na izborima ili na referendumu, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
(2) Ako djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učini član biračkog odbora ili drugo lice u vršenju dužnosti u vezi sa glasanjem, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do tri godine.
Neovlašćeno korišćenje državne imovine u izborne svrhe
Član 193a
Službeno lice koje za predstavljanje izborne liste koristi ili omogući korišćenje imovine državnih organa, javnih ustanova, javnih preduzeća i fondova, jedinica lokalne samouprave i privrednih društava u kojima država ima vlasnički udio, kazniće se zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
Povreda slobode opredjeljena pri  finansiranju političkih subjekata i izbornih kampanja
Član 193b
Ko silom ili prijetnjom ili na drugi protivpravan način utiče da  se političkom subjektu daju novčana, nenovčana ili draga sredstva za  finansiranje izborne kampanje ili finansiranje političkog subjekta, kazniće se  novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do tri godine.
Ako djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učini službeno lice, kazniće se  zatvorom od tri mjeseca do pet godina.
Prihvatanje priloga iz zabranjenih izvora
Član 193v
Odgovorno lice u političkom subjektu koje je moglo i bilo dužno  da zna da sredstva, prilog ili draga korist predstavljaju prihod pribavljen  kriminalnom djelatnošću, kazniće se zatvorom do jedne godine.
Ko učini djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana, a mogao je i bio dužan da  zna da sredstva, prilog ili draga korist predstavljaju prihod pribavljen  kriminalnom djelatnošću, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do pet godina.
Prihvaćena sredstva, prilog ili druga korist oduzeće se.
Teška djela protiv izbornih prava
translated_text:
Article 193

(1) Whoever destroys, damages, takes away or conceals a ballot paper or any other document on voting in elections or in a referendum, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
(2) If the act from paragraph 1 of this Article is committed by a member of an electoral board or another person in the performance of duties related to voting, they shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to three years.
Unauthorized Use of State Property for Electoral Purposes
Article 193a
An official person who for the presentation of an electoral list uses or enables the use of property of state authorities, public institutions, public enterprises and funds, local self-government units and business entities in which the state has an ownership share, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
Violation of Freedom of Choice in Financing Political Subjects and Electoral Campaigns
Article 193b
Whoever by force or threat or in another unlawful manner influences that monetary, non-monetary or other resources be given to a political subject for financing an electoral campaign or financing a political subject, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to three years.
If the act from paragraph 1 of this Article is committed by an official person, they shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years.
Acceptance of Contributions from Prohibited Sources
Article 193v
A responsible person in a political subject who could have and was obliged to know that the resources, contribution or other benefit represent income obtained through criminal activity, shall be punished by imprisonment up to one year.
Whoever commits the act from paragraph 1 of this Article, and could have and was obliged to know that the resources, contribution or other benefit represent income obtained through criminal activity, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years.
The accepted resources, contribution or other benefit shall be confiscated.
Serious Acts against Electoral Rights

heading: Article 194
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 194

(1) Ako je usljed djela iz čl. 185, 186, 187, 189, 190, 191, 192 i 193 ovog zakonika došlo do narušavanja javnog reda i mira i ugrožavanja imovine čija vrijednost prelazi iznos od dvadeset hiljada eura ili je doveden u opasnost život više lica, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
(2) Ako je usljed djela iz čl. 185, 186, 187, 189, 190, 191, 192 i 193 ovog zakonika nastupila teška tjelesna povreda nekog lica ili imovinska šteta koja prelazi iznos od četrdeset hiljada eura, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od jedne do deset godina.
(3) Ako je usljed djela iz čl. 185, 186, 187, 189, 190, 191, 192 i 193 ovog zakonika nastupila smrt jednog ili više lica, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od pet do osamnaest godina.
GLAVA SEDAMNAESTA
KRIVIČNA DJELA PROTIV ČASTI I UGLEDA
Čl. 195 i 196
(brisano)
Iznošenje ličnih i porodičnih prilika
translated_text:
Article 194

(1) If as a result of the act from Art. 185, 186, 187, 189, 190, 191, 192 and 193 of this Code there has been a disturbance of public order and peace and endangerment of property whose value exceeds the amount of twenty thousand euros or the life of several persons has been endangered, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(2) If as a result of the act from Art. 185, 186, 187, 189, 190, 191, 192 and 193 of this Code serious bodily injury to a person or property damage exceeding the amount of forty thousand euros has occurred, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.
(3) If as a result of the act from Art. 185, 186, 187, 189, 190, 191, 192 and 193 of this Code the death of one or more persons has occurred, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from five to eighteen years.
CHAPTER SEVENTEEN
CRIMINAL OFFENCES AGAINST HONOUR AND REPUTATION
Art. 195 and 196
(deleted)
Disclosure of Personal and Family Circumstances

heading: Article 197
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 197

(1) Ko iznosi ili pronosi štogod iz ličnog ili porodičnog života nekog lica što može škoditi njegovoj časti ili ugledu, kazniće se novčanom kaznom od tri hiljade do deset hiljada eura.
(2) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učinjeno putem medija ili sličnih sredstava ili na javnom skupu, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom od pet hiljada do četrnaest hiljada eura.
(3) Ako je ono što se iznosi ili pronosi dovelo ili moglo dovesti do teških posljedica za oštećenog, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom najmanje osam hiljada eura.
(4) Za iznošenje ili pronošenje ličnih ili porodičnih prilika koje je učinjeno u vršenju službene dužnosti, novinarskog poziva, odbrani nekog prava ili pri zaštiti opravdanih interesa, učinilac se neće kazniti, ako dokaže istinitost svog tvrđenja ili ako dokaže da je imao osnovanog razloga da povjeruje u istinitost onog što je iznosio ili pronosio.
(5) Istinitost ili neistinitost onog što se iznosi ili pronosi iz ličnog ili porodičnog života nekog lica ne može se dokazivati, osim u slučajevima iz stava 4 ovog člana.
Povreda ugleda Crne Gore
translated_text:
Article 197

(1) Whoever discloses or spreads something from the personal or family life of a person that may harm their honour or reputation shall be punished by a fine from three thousand to ten thousand euros.
(2) If the act from paragraph 1 of this Article was committed through media or similar means or at a public gathering, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine from five thousand to fourteen thousand euros.
(3) If what was disclosed or spread has led or could have led to serious consequences for the injured party, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine of at least eight thousand euros.
(4) For disclosing or spreading personal or family circumstances committed in the performance of official duty, journalistic profession, defence of a right or in the protection of justified interests, the perpetrator shall not be punished if they prove the truthfulness of their assertion or if they prove that they had reasonable grounds to believe in the truthfulness of what they disclosed or spread.
(5) The truthfulness or untruthfulness of what is disclosed or spread from the personal or family life of a person may not be proven, except in cases from paragraph 4 of this Article.
Violation of the reputation of Montenegro

heading: Article 198
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 198

Ko javno izloži poruzi Crnu Goru, njenu zastavu, grb ili himnu, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
Povreda ugleda naroda, manjinskih naroda i drugih manjinskih nacionalnih zajednica
translated_text:
Article 198

Whoever publicly exposes to ridicule Montenegro, its flag, coat of arms or anthem shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
Violation of the reputation of peoples, minority peoples and other minority national communities

heading: Article 199
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 199

Ko javno izloži poruzi narod, manjinski narod i drugu manjinsku nacionalnu zajednicu koji žive u Crnoj Gori, kazniće se novčanom kaznom od tri hiljade do deset hiljada eura.
Povreda ugleda strane države ili međunarodne organizacije
translated_text:
Article 199

Whoever publicly exposes to ridicule a people, minority people and other minority national community living in Montenegro shall be punished by a fine from three thousand to ten thousand euros.
Violation of the reputation of a foreign state or international organisation

heading: Article 200
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 200

(1) Ko javno izloži poruzi stranu državu sa kojom Crna Gora ima diplomatske odnose, njenu zastavu, grb ili himnu, kazniće se novčanom kaznom od tri hiljade do deset hiljada eura.
(2) Kaznom iz stava 1 ovog člana kazniće se i ko javno izloži poruzi Organizaciju ujedinjenih nacija, Međunarodni crveni krst ili drugu međunarodnu organizaciju čija je Crna Gora član.
Nekažnjavanje za krivična djela iz čl. 198 do 200
translated_text:
Article 200

(1) Whoever publicly exposes to ridicule a foreign state with which Montenegro has diplomatic relations, its flag, coat of arms or anthem shall be punished by a fine from three thousand to ten thousand euros.
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1 of this Article shall also be imposed on whoever publicly exposes to ridicule the United Nations, the International Red Cross or another international organisation of which Montenegro is a member.
Non-punishment for criminal offences from Articles 198 to 200

heading: Article 201
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 201

Neće se kazniti za djelo iz čl. 198 do 200 ovog zakonika učinilac ako je izlaganje dato u okviru ozbiljne kritike u naučnom, književnom ili umjetničkom djelu, u izvršavanju službene dužnosti, novinarskog poziva, političke djelatnosti, u odbrani nekog prava ili zaštite opravdanih interesa, ako se iz načina izražavanja ili iz drugih okolnosti vidi da to nije učinio u namjeri omalovažavanja ili ako dokaže istinitost svog tvrđenja ili da je imao osnovanog razloga da povjeruje u istinitost onoga što je iznosio ili pronosio.
Gonjenje za krivična djela protiv časti i ugleda
translated_text:
Article 201

The perpetrator shall not be punished for the act from Articles 198 to 200 of this Code if the exposure was given in the framework of serious criticism in a scientific, literary or artistic work, in the performance of official duty, journalistic profession, political activity, in the defence of a right or protection of justified interests, if it is evident from the manner of expression or from other circumstances that they did not do so with the intention of disparagement or if they prove the truthfulness of their assertion or that they had reasonable grounds to believe in the truthfulness of what they disclosed or spread.
Prosecution for criminal offences against honour and reputation

heading: Article 202
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 202

(1) Gonjenje za djelo iz člana 197 ovog zakonika preduzima se po privatnoj tužbi.
(2) Ako je djelo iz člana 197 ovog zakonika učinjeno prema umrlom licu, gonjenje se preduzima po privatnoj tužbi bračnog druga ili lica koje je sa umrlim živjelo u trajnoj vanbračnoj zajednici, srodnika u pravoj liniji, usvojioca, usvojenika, brata ili sestre umrlog lica.
(3) Gonjenje za krivično djelo iz člana 200 ovog zakonika preduzima se po odobrenju Vrhovnog državnog tužioca Crne Gore.
Javno objavljivanje presude za krivična djela protiv časti i ugleda
translated_text:
Article 202

(1) Prosecution for the act from Article 197 of this Code shall be undertaken upon private complaint.
(2) If the act from Article 197 of this Code was committed against a deceased person, prosecution shall be undertaken upon private complaint of the spouse or person who lived with the deceased in a permanent extramarital union, relatives in direct line, adopter, adoptee, brother or sister of the deceased person.
(3) Prosecution for the criminal offence from Article 200 of this Code shall be undertaken with the approval of the Supreme State Prosecutor of Montenegro.
Public announcement of judgment for criminal offences against honour and reputation

(1) Pri osudi za djela iz čl. 197 do 200 ovog zakonika učinjena putem medija, sud će izreći mjeru bezbjednosti javnog objavljivanja presude (

heading: Article 77)
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
član 77)

Ukoliko se radi o krivičnom djelu iz člana 197 ovog zakonika za izricanje ove mjere potrebna je saglasnost lica prema kome je djelo izvršeno.
(2) Sud će osloboditi od kazne učinioca krivičnog djela iz člana 197 ovog zakonika i izreći mjeru bezbjednosti javnog objavljivanja presude ako ocijeni da je za postizanje opšte svrhe krivičnih sankcija dovoljno izricanje te mjere.
(3) U slučajevima iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana presuda će se objaviti u istom mediju na istoj strani štampe, odnosno u istoj emisiji elektronskog medija u kojoj je objavljena informacija u kojoj su ostvarena obilježja krivičnog djela ili u glavnim informativnim emisijama. Sud može odlučiti da se presuda objavi i u drugim medijima.
(4) Sud će odrediti da li će se objaviti presuda u cjelini ili u izvodu.
(5) Ukoliko se vrši objavljivanje izvoda, on mora sadržati obavještenje o donošenju presude sa izrekom i dijelom obrazloženja presude po odluci suda.
