(3) If the act from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
Unlawful Performance of Medical Experiments and Drug Testing

heading: Article 291
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 291

(1) Ko protivno propisima na ljudima vrši medicinske ili druge slične eksperimente, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do pet godina.
(2) Kaznom iz stava 1 ovog člana kazniće se i ko vrši intervencije usmjerene na stvaranje ljudskog bića koje je genetski identično sa drugim ljudskim bićem (kloniranje) ili vrši eksperimente u tom cilju.
(3) Ko protivno propisima vrši kliničko ispitivanje lijeka, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do tri godine.
Neukazivanje ljekarske pomoći
translated_text:
Article 291

(1) Whoever, contrary to regulations, performs medical or other similar experiments on humans shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years.
(2) The punishment from paragraph 1 of this Article shall also be imposed on whoever performs interventions aimed at creating a human being that is genetically identical to another human being (cloning) or performs experiments for that purpose.
(3) Whoever, contrary to regulations, performs clinical testing of a drug shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to three years.
Failure to Provide Medical Assistance

heading: Article 292
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 292

(1) Ljekar koji protivno svojoj dužnosti odbije da ukaže ljekarsku pomoć licu kojem je takva pomoć potrebna, a koje se nalazi u neposrednoj opasnosti za život ili opasnosti nastupanja teške tjelesne povrede ili teškog narušavanja zdravlja, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do dvije godine.
(2) Ako usljed djela iz stava 1 ovog člana lice kojem nije ukazana ljekarska pomoć bude teško tjelesno povrijeđeno ili mu zdravlje bude teško narušeno, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od tri mjeseca do četiri godine.
(3) Ako je usljed djela iz stava 1 ovog člana nastupila smrt lica kome nije ukazana ljekarska pomoć, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od jedne do osam godina.
Nadriljekarstvo
translated_text:
Article 292

(1) A physician who, contrary to their duty, refuses to provide medical assistance to a person who needs such assistance and who is in immediate danger to life or danger of occurrence of serious bodily injury or serious impairment of health, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to two years.
(2) If, as a result of the act from paragraph 1 of this Article, the person to whom medical assistance was not provided suffers serious bodily injury or their health is seriously impaired, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to four years.
(3) If, as a result of the act from paragraph 1 of this Article, the death of the person to whom medical assistance was not provided has occurred, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
Quackery

heading: Article 293
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 293

Ko se bez odgovarajuće stručne spreme bavi liječenjem ili pružanjem drugih medicinskih usluga, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do dvije godine.
Protivpravno uzimanje ljudskih organa ili djelova tijela
Član 293a
(1) Ko bez pisane saglasnosti, odnosno pristanka u smislu propisa kojima se uređuje presađivanje organa, od živog ili umrlog lica uzme organ ili dio tijela, kazniće se zatvorom od jedne do osam godina.
(2) Ko uzme organ ili dio tijela od živog ili umrlog lica van okvira domaćeg sistema za presađivanje ili ako uzimanje izvrši kršenjem osnovnih načela i pravila utvrđenih propisima kojima se uređuje presađivanje organa, kazniće se zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
(3) Ko u zamjenu za uzeti organ ili dio tijela ponudi ili da imovinsku ili kakvu drugu korist, kazniće se zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
(4) Ako je usljed djela iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana nastupila smrt ili teško narušavanje zdravlja ili je djelo učinjeno od strane više lica na organizovani način ili zloupotrebom službenog položaja ili je učinjeno prema maloljetnom licu, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od pet do petnaest godina.
Čuvanje, prevoz, uvoz i izvoz ljudskih organa ili djelova tijela
pribavljenih izvršenjem krivičnog djela
Član 293b
(1) Ko priprema, čuva ili skladišti ljudske organe ili djelove tijela pribavljene izvršenjem krivičnog djela iz člana 293a ovog zakona, kazniće se zatvorom od jedne do osam godina.
(2) Kaznom iz stava 1 ovog člana kazniće se i ko prevozi, vrši razmjenu, prima, uvozi ili izvozi ljudske organe ili djelove tijela pribavljene izvršenjem krivičnog djela iz člana 293a ovog zakona.
(3) Ako je djelo iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana učinjeno od strane više lica na organizovan način ili zloupotrebom službenog položaja, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od dvije do dvanaest godina.
translated_text:
Article 293

Whoever, without appropriate professional qualifications, engages in treatment or provision of other medical services shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to two years.
Unlawful Removal of Human Organs or Body Parts
Article 293a
(1) Whoever, without written consent or approval in the sense of regulations governing organ transplantation, removes an organ or body part from a living or deceased person shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(2) Whoever removes an organ or body part from a living or deceased person outside the framework of the domestic transplantation system or if the removal is performed in violation of the basic principles and rules established by regulations governing organ transplantation, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(3) Whoever, in exchange for a removed organ or body part, offers or gives property or any other benefit, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(4) If, as a result of the act from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, death or serious impairment of health has occurred, or the act was committed by multiple persons in an organized manner or by abuse of official position, or was committed against a minor, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from five to fifteen years.
Storage, Transport, Import and Export of Human Organs or Body Parts
Obtained by Commission of a Criminal Offense
Article 293b
(1) Whoever prepares, stores or warehouses human organs or body parts obtained by commission of the criminal offense from Article 293a of this law shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(2) The punishment from paragraph 1 of this Article shall also be imposed on whoever transports, exchanges, receives, imports or exports human organs or body parts obtained by commission of the criminal offense from Article 293a of this law.
(3) If the act from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article was committed by multiple persons in an organized manner or by abuse of official position, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from two to twelve years.

heading: Article 294
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 294

(1) Ljekar koji prije presađivanja dijela tijela ne pribavi u pisanom obliku, pristanak primaoca, odnosno njegovog roditelja, usvojioca ili staraoca, ako je primalac maloljetno ili neuračunljivo lice, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do tri godine.
(2) Kaznom iz stava 1 ovog člana kazniće se i odgovorno lice u zdravstvenoj ustanovi, ako uzima ili presađuje djelove ljudskog tijela ili ispituje podudarnost za presađivanje, a ustanova ne ispunjava za to propisane uslove.
Nedozvoljeno uzimanje djelova tijela radi presađivanja
translated_text:
Article 294

(1) A physician who, before transplanting a body part, does not obtain in written form the consent of the recipient, or their parent, adoptive parent or guardian, if the recipient is a minor or mentally incompetent person, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to three years.
(2) The punishment from paragraph 1 of this Article shall also be imposed on a responsible person in a health institution if they remove or transplant parts of the human body or examine compatibility for transplantation, and the institution does not meet the prescribed conditions for that.
Unauthorized Removal of Body Parts for Transplantation

heading: Article 295
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 295

(1) Ljekar koji radi presađivanja uzme dio tijela od živog, punoljetnog, duševno zdravog i poslovno sposobnog lica bez prethodno pribavljenog pisanog pristanka tog lica ili ako uzme dio tijela živog lica koje nije punoljetno, koje je neuračunljivo ili je poslovno nesposobno bez prethodno pribavljenog pisanog pristanka roditelja, usvojioca ili staraoca, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do četiri godine.
(2) Kaznom iz stava 1 ovog člana kazniće se i ljekar koji radi presađivanja uzme dio tijela umrlog lica čija smrt nije utvrđena na način i u postupku prema propisima o presađivanju djelova ljudskog tijela.
(3) Ljekar koji radi presađivanja uzme dio tijela umrlog lica koje se za života izričito, u pisanom obliku, protivilo uzimanju dijela tijela ili ako uzme dio tijela umrlog maloljetnog ili neuračunljivog lica bez prethodne pisane saglasnosti roditelja, usvojioca ili staraoca, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
(4) Ko uzme ili presadi ljudski organ, tkivo, ćeliju, zametak ili fetus ako je znao ili je mogao i bio dužan da zna da je za njega davalac dobio novčanu naknadu ili drugu korist, kazniće se zatvorom do tri godine.
Trgovina djelovima ljudskog tijela
Član 295a
(1) Ko upotrebom sile ili prijetnje, obmanom, prevarom, otmicom, zloupotrebom položaja ili odnosa zavisnosti nabavi, posjeduje, prevozi, prenosi, čuva ili primi ljudski organ, tkivo, ćeliju, zametak, fetus ili tijelo umrlog lica radi uzimanja dijelova tijela, kazniće se zatvorom od jedne do osam godina.
(2) Ko protivpravno nabavi ljudski organ, tkivo, ćeliju, zametak, fetus ili tijelo umrlog lica, kazniće se zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
(3) Kaznom iz stava 2 ovog člana kazniće se ko u namjeri pribavljanja imovinske koristi navede drugog ili mu pomogne u davanju sopstvenog organa, tkiva, ćelije, zametka ili fetusa za novčanu naknadu ili drugu korist.
Oglašavanje trgovine djelovima ljudskog tijela
Član 295b
Ko oglašava kupovinu ili prodaju ljudskog organa, tkiva, ćelije, zametka, fetusa ili tijela umrlog lica, kazniće se zatvorom do tri godine.
Nesavjesno postupanje pri spravljanju i izdavanju ljekova
translated_text:
Article 295

(1) A physician who, for the purpose of transplantation, removes a body part from a living, adult, mentally healthy and legally competent person without previously obtained written consent of that person, or if they remove a body part from a living person who is not an adult, who is mentally incompetent or is legally incompetent without previously obtained written consent of the parent, adoptive parent or guardian, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to four years.
(2) The punishment from paragraph 1 of this Article shall also be imposed on a physician who, for the purpose of transplantation, removes a body part from a deceased person whose death has not been determined in the manner and procedure according to regulations on transplantation of parts of the human body.
(3) A physician who, for the purpose of transplantation, removes a body part from a deceased person who, during their lifetime, explicitly objected in written form to the removal of body parts, or if they remove a body part from a deceased minor or mentally incompetent person without prior written consent of the parent, adoptive parent or guardian, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
(4) Whoever removes or transplants a human organ, tissue, cell, embryo or fetus if they knew or could have and should have known that the donor received monetary compensation or other benefit for it, shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.
Trafficking in Parts of the Human Body
Article 295a
(1) Whoever, by use of force or threat, deception, fraud, abduction, abuse of position or relationship of dependence, procures, possesses, transports, transfers, stores or receives a human organ, tissue, cell, embryo, fetus or body of a deceased person for the purpose of removing body parts, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(2) Whoever unlawfully procures a human organ, tissue, cell, embryo, fetus or body of a deceased person shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(3) The punishment from paragraph 2 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever, with the intention of obtaining property benefit, induces another or assists them in giving their own organ, tissue, cell, embryo or fetus for monetary compensation or other benefit.
Advertising Trafficking in Parts of the Human Body
Article 295b
Whoever advertises the purchase or sale of a human organ, tissue, cell, embryo, fetus or body of a deceased person shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.
Negligent Conduct in Preparation and Dispensing of Drugs

heading: Article 296
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 296

(1) Lice ovlašćeno za izdavanje ljekova za upotrebu u medicini koje izda drugi lijek umjesto propisanog ili zahtijevanog lijeka, ako zamjena nije dozvoljena ili koje ne napravi lijek u propisanoj razmjeri ili količini ili koje očigledno nesavjesno postupa pri izdavanju ljekova i time prouzrokuje pogoršanje zdravstvenog stanja nekog lica, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do tri godine.
(2) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
Neovlašćeno stavljanje u promet hormonskih supstanci
Član 296a
Ko protivno propisima stavi u promet ljekove ili supstance koje sadrže hormone ili ostale stimulanse rasta, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do tri godine.
Proizvodnja i stavljanje u promet škodljivih proizvoda
translated_text:
Article 296

(1) A person authorized to dispense drugs for use in medicine who dispenses a different drug instead of the prescribed or requested drug, if the substitution is not permitted, or who does not prepare the drug in the prescribed proportion or quantity, or who acts in a manifestly negligent manner when dispensing drugs and thereby causes deterioration of the health condition of a person, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to three years.
(2) If the act from paragraph 1 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
Unauthorized Placing on the Market of Hormonal Substances
Article 296a
Whoever, contrary to regulations, places on the market drugs or substances containing hormones or other growth stimulants shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to three years.
Production and Placing on the Market of Harmful Products

heading: Article 297
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 297

(1) Ko proizvodi radi prodaje, prodaje ili stavlja u promet životne namirnice, jelo ili piće ili druge proizvode škodljive za zdravlje ljudi, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do tri godine.
(2) Ko proizvode iz stava 1 ovog člana stavlja u promet bez izvršenog pregleda od strane ovlašćenog lica, kad je taj pregled propisima predviđen, kazniće se zatvorom do tri godine.
(3) Ako je djelo iz st.1 i 2 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
(4) Predmeti iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana oduzeće se.
Nesavjesno vršenje pregleda životnih namirnica
translated_text:
Article 297

(1) Whoever produces for sale, sells or places on the market foodstuffs, food or drink or other products harmful to human health shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to three years.
(2) Whoever places on the market the products from paragraph 1 of this Article without an inspection performed by an authorized person, when such inspection is prescribed by regulations, shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.
(3) If the act from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
(4) The objects from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall be confiscated.
Negligent Performance of Inspection of Foodstuffs

heading: Article 298
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 298

(1) Ovlašćeno lice koje nesavjesno izvrši pregled stoke za klanje, mesa namijenjenog za ishranu i drugih životnih namirnica ili protivno propisima ne izvrši pregled i time omogući da se stavi u promet meso ili druga životna namirnica škodljiva za zdravlje ljudi, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do tri godine.
(2) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
Zagađivanje vode za piće i životnih namirnica
translated_text:
Article 298

(1) An authorised person who negligently carries out an inspection of livestock for slaughter, meat intended for consumption and other foodstuffs or contrary to regulations fails to carry out an inspection and thereby enables meat or other foodstuffs harmful to human health to be placed on the market, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to three years.
(2) If the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article has been committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
Contamination of drinking water and foodstuffs

heading: Article 299
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 299

(1) Ko kakvom škodljivom materijom zagadi vodu koja ljudima služi za piće ili životne namirnice, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do tri godine.
(2) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
Neovlašćena proizvodnja, držanje i stavljanje u promet opojnih droga
translated_text:
Article 299

(1) Whoever contaminates with any harmful substance water that serves people for drinking or foodstuffs, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to three years.
(2) If the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article has been committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
Unauthorised production, possession and placing on the market of narcotic drugs

heading: Article 300
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 300

(1) Ko neovlašćeno proizvodi, prerađuje, prodaje ili nudi na prodaju ili ko radi prodaje kupuje, drži ili prenosi ili ko posreduje u prodaji ili kupovini ili na drugi način neovlašćeno stavlja u promet supstance koje su proglašene za opojne droge ili biljke koje sadrže takve supstance, kazniće se zatvorom od dvije do deset godina.
(2) Ko u namjeri vršenja djela iz stava 1 ovog člana unese u Crnu Goru supstance koje su iroglašene za opojne droge ili biljke koje sadrže takve supstance, kazniće se zatvorom od dvije do dvanaest godina.
(3) Ako je učinilac djela iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana organizovao mrežu preprodavaca ili posrednika, kazniće se zatvorom od tri do petnaest godina.
(4) Kaznom iz stava 3 ovog člana kazniće se ko prodaje, nudi na prodaju ili bez naknade radi daljeg stavljanja u promet daje opojne droge maloljetnom licu, duševno bolesnom licu, licu koje je privremeno duševno poremećeno, licu koje je teže duševno zaostalo ili licu koje se liječi od zavisnosti od opojnih droga, ili ko stavlja u promet opojnu drogu pomiješanu sa supstancom koja može dovesti do teškog narušavanja zdravlja, ili ko izvrši djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana u vaspitnoj ili obrazovnoj ustanovi ili u njenoj neposrednoj blizini ili ustanovi za izvršenje krivičnih sankcija ili u javnom lokalu ili na javnoj priredbi, ili ako djelo iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana učini službeno lice, ljekar, socijalni radnik, sveštenik, nastavnik ili vaspitač iskorišćavanjem svog položaja ili ko za izvršenje tog djela koristi maloljetno lice.
(5) Učinilac djela iz st. 1 do 4 ovog člana koji otkrije od koga nabavlja drogu može se osloboditi od kazne.
(6) Ko neovlašćeno pravi, nabavlja, posjeduje, prevozi ili daje na upotrebu opremu, materijal ili supstance za koje zna da su namijenjene za proizvodnju opojnih droga, kazniće se zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
(7) Opojne droge i sredstva za njihovo pravljenje oduzeće se i uništiti.
Omogućavanje uživanja opojnih droga
translated_text:
Article 300

(1) Whoever unauthorisedly produces, processes, sells or offers for sale or for the purpose of sale purchases, possesses or transfers or mediates in the sale or purchase or in any other way unauthorisedly places on the market substances that have been declared narcotic drugs or plants containing such substances, shall be punished by imprisonment from two to ten years.
(2) Whoever with the intention of committing the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article brings into Montenegro substances that have been declared narcotic drugs or plants containing such substances, shall be punished by imprisonment from two to twelve years.
(3) If the perpetrator of the offence referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article has organised a network of resellers or intermediaries, he shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.
(4) The penalty referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever sells, offers for sale or without compensation for the purpose of further placing on the market gives narcotic drugs to a minor, a mentally ill person, a person who is temporarily mentally disturbed, a person who is severely mentally retarded or a person who is being treated for addiction to narcotic drugs, or whoever places on the market a narcotic drug mixed with a substance that may lead to serious impairment of health, or whoever commits the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article in an educational or training institution or in its immediate vicinity or in an institution for the execution of criminal sanctions or in a public premises or at a public event, or if the offence referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article is committed by an official, doctor, social worker, priest, teacher or educator by exploiting his position or whoever uses a minor to commit that offence.
(5) The perpetrator of the offence referred to in paragraphs 1 to 4 of this Article who reveals from whom he obtains the drug may be exempted from punishment.
(6) Whoever unauthorisedly manufactures, procures, possesses, transports or makes available for use equipment, material or substances which he knows are intended for the production of narcotic drugs, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(7) Narcotic drugs and means for their manufacture shall be confiscated and destroyed.
Enabling the use of narcotic drugs

heading: Article 301
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 301

(1) Ko navodi drugog na uživanje opojne droge ili mu daje opojnu drogu da je uživa on ili drugo lice ili stavi na raspolaganje prostorije radi uživanja opojne droge ili na drugi način omogućuje drugom da uživa opojnu drogu, kazniće se zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
(2) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učinjeno prema maloljetnom licu, duševno bolesnom licu, licu koje je privremeno duševno poremećeno, licu koje je teže duševno zaostalo ili licu koje se liječi od zavisnosti od opojnih droga, ili prema više lica, ili ko to djelo izvrši u vaspitnoj ili obrazovnoj ustanovi ili u njenoj neposrednoj blizini ili ustanovi za izvršenje krivičnih sankcija ili u javnom lokalu ili na javnoj priredbi, ili ako to djelo učini službeno lice, ljekar, socijalni radnik, sveštenik, nastavnik ili vaspitač iskorišćavanjem svog položaja, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od dvije do deset godina.
(3) Opojne droge oduzeće se i uništiti.
Teška djela protiv zdravlja ljudi
translated_text:
Article 301

(1) Whoever induces another to use a narcotic drug or gives him a narcotic drug for him or another person to use or makes premises available for the use of a narcotic drug or in any other way enables another to use a narcotic drug, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(2) If the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article has been committed against a minor, a mentally ill person, a person who is temporarily mentally disturbed, a person who is severely mentally retarded or a person who is being treated for addiction to narcotic drugs, or against several persons, or whoever commits that offence in an educational or training institution or in its immediate vicinity or in an institution for the execution of criminal sanctions or in public premises or at a public event, or if that offence is committed by an official, doctor, social worker, priest, teacher or educator by exploiting his position, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from two to ten years.
(3) Narcotic drugs shall be confiscated and destroyed.
Serious offences against human health

heading: Article 302
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 302

(1) Ako usljed djela iz čl. 287 i 290 st. 1 i 2, 291, 293, 296 stav 1, 297 st. 1 i 2, 298 stav 1 i 299 stav 1 ovog zakonika, neko lice bude teško tjelesno povrijeđeno ili mu zdravlje bude teško narušeno, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od jedne do osam godina.
(2) Ako je usljed djela iz čl. 287 i 290. st. 1 i 2, 291, 293, 296 stav 1, 297 st. 1 i 2, 298 stav 1 i 299 stav 1 ovog zakonika nastupila smrt jednog ili više lica, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od dvije do dvanaest godina.
(3) Ako usljed djela iz čl. 290 stav 3, 296 stav 2, 297 stav 3, 298 stav 2 i 299 stav 2 ovog zakonika neko lice bude teško tjelesno povrijeđeno ili mu zdravlje bude teško narušeno, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom do četiri godine.
(4) Ako je usljed djela iz čl. 290 stav 3, 296 stav 2, 297 stav 3, 298 stav 2 i 299 stav 2 ovog zakonika nastupila smrt, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od jedne do osam godine.
GLAVA DVADESET PETA
KRIVIČNA DJELA PROTIV ŽIVOTNE SREDINE I UREĐENjA PROSTORA
Zagađenje životne sredine
translated_text:
Article 302

(1) If as a result of the offence referred to in Articles 287 and 290 paragraphs 1 and 2, 291, 293, 296 paragraph 1, 297 paragraphs 1 and 2, 298 paragraph 1 and 299 paragraph 1 of this Code, any person is seriously bodily injured or his health is seriously impaired, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(2) If as a result of the offence referred to in Articles 287 and 290 paragraphs 1 and 2, 291, 293, 296 paragraph 1, 297 paragraphs 1 and 2, 298 paragraph 1 and 299 paragraph 1 of this Code the death of one or more persons has occurred, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from two to twelve years.
(3) If as a result of the offence referred to in Articles 290 paragraph 3, 296 paragraph 2, 297 paragraph 3, 298 paragraph 2 and 299 paragraph 2 of this Code any person is seriously bodily injured or his health is seriously impaired, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment up to four years.
(4) If as a result of the offence referred to in Articles 290 paragraph 3, 296 paragraph 2, 297 paragraph 3, 298 paragraph 2 and 299 paragraph 2 of this Code death has occurred, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
CHAPTER TWENTY-FIVE
CRIMINAL OFFENCES AGAINST THE ENVIRONMENT AND SPATIAL PLANNING
Pollution of the environment

heading: Član 303
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 303

(1) Ko kršeći propise o zaštiti, očuvanju i unaprjeđenju životne sredine ispusti, unese ili odloži određenu količinu materije ili jonizujućeg zračenja u vazduh, vodu ili zemljište kojom izazove opasnost za život, tijelo ili zdravlje ljudi ili opasnost od nastupanja znatne štete u odnosu na kvalitet vazduha, vode ili zemljišta ili za životinjski ili biljni svijet, kazniće se zatvorom do tri godine.
(2) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
(3) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana prouzrokovalo znatnu štetu u odnosu na kvalitet vazduha, vode ili zemljišta ili uništenje ili znatno oštećenje životinjskog ili biljnog svijeta, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od jedne do osam godina.
(4) Ako je djelo iz stava 3 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od tri mjeseca do pet godina.
(5) Ako je usljed djela iz stava 1 ovog člana nastupila teška tjelesna povreda ili teško narušavanje zdravlja jednog ili više lica, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od dvije do deset godina.
(6) Ako je usljed djela iz stava 1 ovog člana nastupila smrt jednog ili više lica, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od tri do dvanaest godina.
(7) Ako izrekne uslovnu osudu za djela iz st. 1 do 4 ovog člana, sud može odrediti obavezu učiniocu da u određenom roku preduzme određene propisane mjere zaštite, očuvanja i unaprjeđenja životne sredine.
Zagađenje životne sredine otpadom
Član 303a
(1) Ko sakupljanjem, prevozom, preradom, odlaganjem ili odstranjivanjem otpada izazove opasnost za život, tijelo ili zdravlje ljudi ili opasnost od nastupanja znatne štete u odnosu na kvalitet vazduha, vode ili zemljišta ili za životinjski ili biljni svijet, kazniće se zatvorom do tri godine.
(2) Ko djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učini vršeći nadzor nad djelatnostima prikupljanja, prevoza, prerade, odlaganja ili odstranjivanja otpada ili vršeći naknadno održavanje mjesta za odlaganje otpada ili trgovinom otpadom ili organizovanjem prerade ili odstranjivanja otpada u tuđe ime, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do tri godine.
(3) Ako je djelo iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
(4) Ako je djelo iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana prouzrokovalo znatnu štetu u odnosu na kvalitet vazduha, vode ili zemljišta ili uništenje ili znatno oštećenje životinjskog ili biljnog svijeta, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od jedne do osam godina.
(5) Ako je djelo iz stava 4 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od tri mjeseca do pet godina.
(6) Ako je usljed djela iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana nastupila teška tjelesna povreda ili teško narušavanje zdravlja jednog ili više lica, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od dvije do deset godina.
(7) Ako je usljed djela iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana nastupila smrt jednog ili više lica, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od tri do dvanaest godina.
Oštećenje ozonskog omotača
Član 303b
Ko proizvodi ili protivno propisima uvozi, izvozi, stavlja u promet ili koristi materije koje oštećuju ozonski omotač, kazniće se zatvorom do tri godine.
Nepreduzimanje mjera zaštite životne sredine
translated_text:
Član 303

(1) Whoever, in violation of regulations on the protection, preservation and improvement of the environment, discharges, introduces or deposits a certain quantity of matter or ionizing radiation into the air, water or soil, thereby causing danger to the life, body or health of people or danger of occurrence of significant damage in relation to the quality of air, water or soil or to animal or plant life, shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.
(2) If the act from paragraph 1 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
(3) If the act from paragraph 1 of this Article caused significant damage in relation to the quality of air, water or soil or destruction or significant damage to animal or plant life, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(4) If the act from paragraph 3 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years.
(5) If as a result of the act from paragraph 1 of this Article serious bodily injury or serious impairment of health of one or more persons occurred, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from two to ten years.
(6) If as a result of the act from paragraph 1 of this Article the death of one or more persons occurred, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three to twelve years.
(7) If it pronounces a suspended sentence for acts from paragraphs 1 to 4 of this Article, the court may impose an obligation on the perpetrator to undertake certain prescribed measures for the protection, preservation and improvement of the environment within a specified period.
Zagađenje životne sredine otpadom
Član 303a
(1) Whoever, by collecting, transporting, processing, disposing or removing waste, causes danger to the life, body or health of people or danger of occurrence of significant damage in relation to the quality of air, water or soil or to animal or plant life, shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.
(2) Whoever commits the act from paragraph 1 of this Article while exercising supervision over activities of collecting, transporting, processing, disposing or removing waste or while performing subsequent maintenance of waste disposal sites or through waste trading or by organizing processing or removal of waste on behalf of others, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to three years.
(3) If the act from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
(4) If the act from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article caused significant damage in relation to the quality of air, water or soil or destruction or significant damage to animal or plant life, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(5) If the act from paragraph 4 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years.
(6) If as a result of the act from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article serious bodily injury or serious impairment of health of one or more persons occurred, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from two to ten years.
(7) If as a result of the act from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article the death of one or more persons occurred, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three to twelve years.
Oštećenje ozonskog omotača
Član 303b
Whoever produces or contrary to regulations imports, exports, places on the market or uses substances that damage the ozone layer, shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.
Nepreduzimanje mjera zaštite životne sredine

(2) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do šest mjeseci.
(3) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana prouzrokovalo znatnu štetu u odnosu na kvalitet vazduha, vode ili zemljišta ili uništenje ili znatno oštećenje životinjskog ili biljnog svijeta, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
(4) Ako je djelo iz stava 3 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom do tri godine.

heading: Član 305
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 305

(1) Službeno ili odgovorno lice koje protivno propisima o zaštiti, očuvanju i unaprjeđenju životne sredine dozvoli izgradnju, stavljanje u pogon, upotrebu ili rad objekta ili postrojenja u kojem se obavlja opasna djelatnost ili u kojem se skladište ili koriste opasne materije ili preparati i time izvan tog objekta ili postrojenja izazove opasnost za život, tijelo ili zdravlje ljudi ili opasnost od nastupanja znatne štete u odnosu na kvalitet vazduha, vode ili zemljišta ili za životinjski ili biljni svijet, kazniće se zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
(2) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana prouzrokovalo znatnu štetu u odnosu na kvalitet vazduha, vode ili zemljišta ili uništenje ili znatno oštećenje životinjskog ili biljnog svijeta, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od jedne do osam godina.
(3) Ako je usljed djela iz stava 1 ovog člana nastupila teška tjelesna povreda ili teško narušavanje zdravlja jednog ili više lica, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od jedne do deset godina.
(4) Ako je usljed djela iz stava 1 ovog člana nastupila smrt jednog ili više lica, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od dvije do dvanaest godina.
(5) Ako izrekne uslovnu osudu za djela iz st. 1 i 2 ovog člana, sud može odrediti obavezu učiniocu da u određenom roku preduzme određene propisane mjere zaštite, očuvanja i unaprjeđenja životne sredine.
Oštećenje objekata i uređaja za zaštitu životne sredine
translated_text:
Član 305

(1) An official or responsible person who, contrary to regulations on the protection, preservation and improvement of the environment, permits the construction, putting into operation, use or operation of a facility or installation in which a hazardous activity is carried out or in which hazardous substances or preparations are stored or used, and thereby causes outside that facility or installation danger to the life, body or health of people or danger of occurrence of significant damage in relation to the quality of air, water or soil or to animal or plant life, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(2) If the act from paragraph 1 of this Article caused significant damage in relation to the quality of air, water or soil or destruction or significant damage to animal or plant life, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(3) If as a result of the act from paragraph 1 of this Article serious bodily injury or serious impairment of health of one or more persons occurred, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.
(4) If as a result of the act from paragraph 1 of this Article the death of one or more persons occurred, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from two to twelve years.
(5) If it pronounces a suspended sentence for acts from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, the court may impose an obligation on the perpetrator to undertake certain prescribed measures for the protection, preservation and improvement of the environment within a specified period.
Oštećenje objekata i uređaja za zaštitu životne sredine

text:
Član 306

(1) Ko ošteti, uništi, ukloni ili na drugi način učini neupotrebljivim objekte ili uređaje za zaštitu životne sredine, kazniće se zatvorom do tri godine.
(2) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
(3) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana prouzrokovalo znatnu štetu u odnosu na kvalitet vazduha, vode ili zemljišta ili uništenje ili znatno oštećenje životinjskog ili biljnog svijeta, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
(4) Ako je djelo iz stava 3 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom do tri godine.
(5) Ako izrekne uslovnu osudu za djela iz st. 1 do 4 ovog člana, sud može odrediti obavezu učiniocu da u određenom roku preduzme određene propisane mjere zaštite, očuvanja i unaprjeđenja životne sredine.

translated_text:
Član 306

(1) Whoever damages, destroys, removes or otherwise renders unusable facilities or devices for the protection of the environment, shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.
(2) If the act from paragraph 1 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment up to one year.
(3) If the act from paragraph 1 of this Article caused significant damage in relation to the quality of air, water or soil or destruction or significant damage to animal or plant life, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.

heading: Article 307
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 307

(1) Ko kršeći propise, korišćenjem prirodnih bogatstava, izgradnjom objekata, izvođenjem kakvih radova ili na drugi način izazove oštećenje životne sredine u većoj mjeri ili na širem prostoru, kazniće se zatvorom do tri godine.
(2) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
(3) Ako je usljed djela iz stava 1 ovog člana došlo do uništenja ili oštećenja životinjskog ili biljnog svijeta velikih razmjera ili do zagađenja životne sredine u toj mjeri da su za njegovo otklanjanje potrebni duže vrijeme ili veliki troškovi, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od jedne do osam godina.
(4) Ako je usljed djela iz stava 2 ovog člana došlo do uništenja ili oštećenja životinjskog ili biljnog svijeta velikih razmjera ili do zagađenja životne sredine u toj mjeri da su za njegovo otklanjanje potrebni duže vrijeme ili veliki troškovi, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
(5) Ako izrekne uslovnu osudu za djela iz st. 1 do 4 ovog člana, sud može odrediti obavezu učiniocu da u određenom roku preduzme određene propisane mjere zaštite, očuvanja i unapređenja životne sredine.
Zloupotreba genetički modifikovanih organizama
Član 307a
(1) Ko kršeći propise proizvodi radi prodaje, prodaje ili stavlja u promet proizvode koji sadrže, sastoje se ili su dobijeni od genetički modifikovanih organizama i time ugrozi životnu sredinu, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
(2) Ko otpad koji sadrži, sastoji se ili je dobijen od genetički modifikovanih organizama ne uništava na način da genetički modifikovani organizam više ne bude sposoban za reprodukciju ili prenos genetičkog materijala na druge organizme, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.
Uništenje biljaka
translated_text:
Article 307

(1) Whoever, by violating regulations, through the use of natural resources, construction of facilities, performance of any works or in any other manner causes damage to the environment to a greater extent or over a wider area, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(2) If the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(3) If as a result of the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article there has been destruction or damage to animal or plant life on a large scale or pollution of the environment to such an extent that its elimination requires a long time or great expense, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.
(4) If as a result of the offence referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article there has been destruction or damage to animal or plant life on a large scale or pollution of the environment to such an extent that its elimination requires a long time or great expense, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(5) If a suspended sentence is imposed for the offences referred to in paragraphs 1 to 4 of this Article, the court may impose an obligation on the perpetrator to undertake certain prescribed measures for the protection, preservation and improvement of the environment within a specified period.
Abuse of Genetically Modified Organisms
Article 307a
(1) Whoever, by violating regulations, produces for sale, sells or places on the market products that contain, consist of or are derived from genetically modified organisms and thereby endangers the environment, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(2) Whoever does not destroy waste that contains, consists of or is derived from genetically modified organisms in such a manner that the genetically modified organism is no longer capable of reproduction or transfer of genetic material to other organisms, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
Destruction of Plants

heading: Article 308
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 308

(1) Ko kršeći propise uništava ili oštećuje biljke u većoj mjeri ili na širem prostoru, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
(2) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učinjeno prema posebno zaštićenim biljnim vrstama, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
(3) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do šest mjeseci.
(4) Ako je djelo iz stava 2 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti zatvorom do tri godine.
(5) Ko neovlašćeno posjeduje biljke koje pripadaju posebno zaštićenoj biljnoj vrsti ili uzima uzorke te vrste, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
Ubijanje i mučenje životinja i razaranje njihovog staništa
translated_text:
Article 308

(1) Whoever, by violating regulations, destroys or damages plants to a greater extent or over a wider area, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(2) If the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article was committed against specially protected plant species, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(3) If the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to six months.
(4) If the offence referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.
(5) Whoever unlawfully possesses plants belonging to a specially protected plant species or takes samples of that species, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
Killing and Torturing Animals and Destroying Their Habitat

heading: Article 309
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 309

(1) Ko kršeći propise ubije, povrijedi ili muči životinju, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
(2) Ko ubija ili povređuje životinje koje pripadaju posebno zaštićenim životinjskim vrstama, kazniće se zatvorom od šest mjeseci do pet godina.
(3) Kaznom iz stava 2 ovog člana kazniće se i ko znatno ošteti ili razori stanište životinja u okviru zaštićenog područja.
(4) Ko neovlašćeno posjeduje životinje koje pripadaju posebno zaštićenoj životinjskoj vrsti ili uzima uzorke te vrste, kazniće se novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do jedne godine.
Uništenje i oštećenje zaštićenog prirodnog dobra
translated_text:
Article 309

(1) Whoever, by violating regulations, kills, injures or tortures an animal, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
(2) Whoever kills or injures animals belonging to specially protected animal species, shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.
(3) The penalty referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article shall also be imposed on whoever significantly damages or destroys the habitat of animals within a protected area.
(4) Whoever unlawfully possesses animals belonging to a specially protected animal species or takes samples of that species, shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to one year.
Destruction and Damage of Protected Natural Property

heading: Article 310
heading_path: CRIMINAL CODE of Montenegro | Paragraf Lex
text:
Član 310

(1) Ko uništi ili ošteti zaštićeno prirodno dobro, kazniće se zatvorom od tri mjeseca do pet godine.
(2) Ako je djelo iz stava 1 ovog člana učinjeno iz nehata, učinilac će se kazniti novčanom kaznom ili zatvorom do šest mjeseci.
Krađa zaštićenog prirodnog dobra
translated_text:
Article 310

(1) Whoever destroys or damages protected natural property, shall be punished by imprisonment from three months to five years.
(2) If the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for up to six months.
Theft of Protected Natural Property
